content:
Table: analytics_insight.buyer_np
Type: base table

Columns:
- buyer_np_name: Full display name of the Buyer Network Participant registered on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.buyer_np."buyer_np_name")
- buyer_np: Unique identifier (subscriber ID) of the Buyer Network Participant on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.buyer_np."buyer_np")
- updated_date: Date when this Buyer NP record was last updated in the data warehouse. (Formula: analytics_insight.buyer_np."updated_date")
- bnp_mask: Masked or anonymized alias of the Buyer NP used for reporting and privacy-safe analytics. (Formula: analytics_insight.buyer_np."bnp_mask")
- domain: ONDC commerce domain in which the Buyer NP operates (e.g., retail, grocery, food and beverage, mobility). (Formula: analytics_insight.buyer_np."domain")
- tsp_powered: Indicates whether the Buyer NP's platform is built on or powered by a third-party Technology Service Provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.buyer_np."tsp_powered")
- spoc_email: Email address of the Single Point of Contact responsible for this Buyer NP. (Formula: analytics_insight.buyer_np."spoc_email")

Table: analytics_insight.cancellation_code
Type: base table

Columns:
- code: Unique ONDC-defined cancellation code that identifies a specific cancellation reason (e.g., 001, 002) as standardized across the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.cancellation_code."code")
- reason_for_cancellation: Human-readable description of why an order or item was cancelled, corresponding to the cancellation code. (Formula: analytics_insight.cancellation_code."reason_for_cancellation")
- is_triggers_rto: Indicates whether this cancellation reason triggers a Return To Origin shipment, meaning the logistics provider must return goods to the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.cancellation_code."is_triggers_rto")
- by: Identifies which party initiated the cancellation, such as buyer, seller NP, or logistics NP. (Formula: analytics_insight.cancellation_code."by")
- attributed_to: Indicates which party bears responsibility or accountability for the cancellation, used for penalty and performance attribution across NPs. (Formula: analytics_insight.cancellation_code."attributed_to")
- whether_applicable_for_part_cancel: Indicates whether this cancellation code can be applied to a partial cancellation of an order rather than requiring full order cancellation. (Formula: analytics_insight.cancellation_code."whether_applicable_for_part_cancel")
- sorting: Numeric or alphanumeric ordering value used to control display sequence of cancellation codes in reports or dropdowns. (Formula: analytics_insight.cancellation_code."sorting")

Table: analytics_insight.od_pincode
Type: base table

Columns:
- Pincode: 6-digit Indian postal code uniquely identifying a delivery or pickup location within the ONDC logistics network. (Formula: analytics_insight.od_pincode."Pincode")
- Districtname: Name of the district in which the pincode falls, used for regional logistics aggregation and serviceability mapping. (Formula: analytics_insight.od_pincode."Districtname")
- Statename: Full name of the Indian state to which the pincode belongs, used for state-level reporting and compliance segmentation. (Formula: analytics_insight.od_pincode."Statename")
- Statecode: Standardised numeric or alpha code representing the state, used for joining with government reference data and filtering in analytics queries. (Formula: analytics_insight.od_pincode."Statecode")

Table: analytics_insight.order_level
Type: base table

Columns:
- Buyer NP: Network Participant (platform/app) through which the buyer placed the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Buyer NP")
- Seller NP: Network Participant (platform/app) on which the seller is registered and fulfills orders. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Seller NP")
- Network order id: Unique order identifier assigned across the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Network order id")
- Provider Id: Unique identifier for the seller's store or outlet on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Provider Id")
- Seller Name: Trading name of the seller or store fulfilling the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Seller Name")
- Seller Pincode: Indian postal code of the seller's warehouse or pickup location. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Seller Pincode")
- Delivery Pincode: Indian postal code of the buyer's delivery address. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Delivery Pincode")
- cancellation_code: Standardized ONDC reason code explaining why the order was cancelled. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."cancellation_code")
- Created at: Timestamp when the order was first created on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Created at")
- Date: Calendar date on which the order was created. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Date")
- domain: ONDC commerce vertical the order belongs to (e.g., retail, food, mobility). (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."domain")
- on-time-del: Binary flag or score indicating whether the order was delivered within the promised time. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."on-time-del")
- Shipped at: Timestamp when the LSP marked the order as dispatched or picked up from the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Shipped at")
- Ready to Ship: Timestamp when the seller marked the order as packed and ready for LSP pickup. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Ready to Ship")
- Promised time: Timestamp by which delivery was contractually promised to the buyer. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Promised time")
- tat_dif: Difference between actual delivery time and promised TAT, expressed in hours or fractional days. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."tat_dif")
- tat_diff_days: TAT deviation (actual minus promised delivery time) expressed in whole or fractional days. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."tat_diff_days")
- day_diff: Day-level difference between two key order lifecycle timestamps used for SLA tracking. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."day_diff")
- min_diff: Minute-level difference between two key order lifecycle timestamps for fine-grained latency analysis. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."min_diff")
- tat_time: Actual end-to-end turn-around-time for the order from creation to delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."tat_time")
- no_key: Surrogate integer key or row sequence number uniquely identifying each record. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."no_key")
- ONDC order_status: Final or current status of the order as per ONDC protocol state machine (e.g., Created, Completed, Cancelled). (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."ONDC order_status")
- Updated at: Timestamp of the most recent status update received for the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Updated at")
- Category: Specific product or service category of the ordered item. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Category")
- Consolidated_category: Broader grouped category used for aggregated reporting and cross-domain analysis. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."Consolidated_category")
- network_transaction_id: ONDC network-level transaction identifier linking all protocol messages belonging to one order flow. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."network_transaction_id")
- modified_date: Date when the order record was last modified or refreshed in the data warehouse. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."modified_date")
- is_force_cancelled: Flag indicating whether the order was forcibly cancelled by the network or admin rather than by buyer or seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."is_force_cancelled")
- c_context_timestamp: Canonical event timestamp from the ONDC protocol message context object representing the official event time. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."c_context_timestamp")
- f_agent_assigned_at: Timestamp when a delivery agent was assigned to the shipment by the LSP. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."f_agent_assigned_at")
- f_rto_initiated_at: Timestamp when the Return To Origin process was formally initiated after a failed delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."f_rto_initiated_at")
- f_rto_delivered_at: Timestamp when the undelivered shipment was successfully returned and delivered back to the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."f_rto_delivered_at")
- f_rto_requested_at: Timestamp when the Return To Origin was first requested, before formal initiation. (Formula: analytics_insight.order_level."f_rto_requested_at")

Table: analytics_insight.ordernhm
Type: view

Columns:
- Date: Calendar date of the order, used as the primary time dimension for reporting. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Date")
- Seller NP: Display name of the Seller Network Participant (the platform/app through which the seller lists products on ONDC). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Seller NP")
- Buyer NP: Display name of the Buyer Network Participant (the platform/app through which the buyer placed the order on ONDC). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Buyer NP")
- Network order id: Unique identifier assigned to the order across the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Network order id")
- provider key: Surrogate lookup key formed by lowercasing the concatenation of Seller NP code and Provider Id, uniquely identifying a seller storefront. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."provider key")
- Provider Id: ONDC-assigned unique identifier for the seller/provider entity. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Provider Id")
- Seller Name: Registered name of the seller or store fulfilling the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Seller Name")
- Seller Pincode: Indian postal code (pincode) of the seller's dispatch location. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Seller Pincode")
- Delivery Pincode: Indian postal code (pincode) of the buyer's delivery destination. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Delivery Pincode")
- cancellation_code: ONDC-standardised code identifying the specific reason an order was cancelled. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."cancellation_code")
- Created at: Timestamp when the order was originally placed on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Created at")
- Updated at: Timestamp of the most recent status update on the order (e.g., delivered or cancelled). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Updated at")
- Shipped at: Timestamp when the order was physically dispatched or handed to the logistics provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Shipped at")
- Ready to Ship: Timestamp when the seller marked the order as packed and ready for pickup. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Ready to Ship")
- Promised time: Committed delivery deadline (end of contracted TAT window) communicated to the buyer. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Promised time")
- domain: ONDC business domain of the order (e.g., retail, F&B, grocery, fashion). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."domain")
- on-time-del: Binary flag (1 = on time, 0 = late) indicating whether the order was delivered within the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."on-time-del")
- tat_dif: Numeric indicator of TAT compliance; 0 means delivered within TAT, positive value indicates a breach. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."tat_dif")
- tat_diff_days: TAT breach or surplus expressed in fractional days. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."tat_diff_days")
- day_diff: Number of calendar days elapsed between order creation and delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."day_diff")
- min_diff: Number of minutes elapsed between order creation (or ready-to-ship) and delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."min_diff")
- tat_time: Total turn-around time in minutes from order creation to delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."tat_time")
- Category: ONDC product category of the order (e.g., F&B, Grocery, Electronics). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Category")
- Consolidated_category: Rolled-up higher-level grouping of product categories for summary reporting. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Consolidated_category")
- ONDC order_status: Current lifecycle status of the order on the ONDC network (Delivered, Cancelled, In Process, Part Delivered). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."ONDC order_status")
- no_key: Row-level counting unit (always 1 per order row) used as the base metric for aggregations. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."no_key")
- Confirmed: Count of confirmed orders (equals no_key for every row, i.e., 1 per order). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Confirmed")
- Delivered: Count flag that equals no_key (1) when the order status is Delivered, else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Delivered")
- Cancelled: Count flag that equals no_key (1) when the order status is Cancelled, else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Cancelled")
- In Process: Count flag that equals no_key (1) when the order status is In Process, else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."In Process")
- Part Delivered: Count flag that equals no_key (1) when the order status is Part Delivered, else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Part Delivered")
- SNP: Normalised Seller Network Participant code from the reference table; defaults to 'Others' if unmapped. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."SNP")
- BNP: Normalised Buyer Network Participant code from the reference table; defaults to 'Others' if unmapped. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."BNP")
- Cancellation code cal: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether a cancellation code is recorded for the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Cancellation code cal")
- Tat breach: TAT breach value coalesced to 0 for null; used as a safe numeric measure of TAT overrun. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Tat breach")
- Delivered with TAT: Count flag (no_key) for orders that were delivered on or within the promised TAT (tat_dif = 0). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Delivered with TAT")
- Delivered beyond TAT: Count flag (no_key) for orders that were delivered after the promised TAT (tat_dif > 0). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Delivered beyond TAT")
- DBO: Count flag (no_key) for orders delivered on or before the promised time (Updated at <= Promised time). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."DBO")
- Breach (mins): Signed minutes between the actual closure time (or current time for in-process) and the promised delivery time; positive = late, negative = early. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Breach (mins)")
- Breach (hrs): Same TAT breach duration expressed in hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Breach (hrs)")
- Breach (days): Same TAT breach duration expressed in fractional days. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Breach (days)")
- Same Day: Count flag for delivered orders where creation and delivery occurred on the same calendar day (day_diff = 0). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Same Day")
- Next Day: Count flag for delivered orders where delivery occurred one calendar day after order creation (day_diff = 1). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Next Day")
- Day + 2: Count flag for delivered orders that arrived exactly two calendar days after creation (day_diff = 2). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Day + 2")
- More than 2 Days: Count flag for delivered orders that took more than two calendar days to arrive (day_diff > 2). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."More than 2 Days")
- On time deliveries: On-time delivery indicator with nulls replaced by 0, safe for summing across all orders. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."On time deliveries")
- Average TAT (in mins): Actual end-to-end TAT in minutes for delivered orders; null for non-delivered orders. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Average TAT (in mins)")
- Avg Delivery (mins): Actual delivery duration in minutes for delivered orders where a positive min_diff is recorded; null otherwise. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Avg Delivery (mins)")
- F&B mins diff: Elapsed minutes from order creation to delivery specifically for Food & Beverage category orders. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."F&B mins diff")
- Within 15 mins: Count flag for F&B delivered orders completed within 15 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Within 15 mins")
- 15 - 30 mins: Count flag for F&B delivered orders completed in 15–30 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."15 - 30 mins")
- 30 - 45 mins: Count flag for F&B delivered orders completed in 30–45 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."30 - 45 mins")
- 45 - 60 mins: Count flag for F&B delivered orders completed in 45–60 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."45 - 60 mins")
- 60 - 120 mins: Count flag for F&B delivered orders completed in 60–120 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."60 - 120 mins")
- Above 120 mins: Count flag for F&B delivered orders taking more than 120 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Above 120 mins")
- TAT < 5 mins: Count flag for orders with a TAT of less than 5 minutes (hyperlocal/instant delivery). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT < 5 mins")
- TAT 5-15 mins: Count flag for orders with a TAT between 5 and 15 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT 5-15 mins")
- TAT 15-30 mins: Count flag for orders with a TAT between 15 and 30 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT 15-30 mins")
- TAT 30-60 mins: Count flag for orders with a TAT between 30 and 60 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT 30-60 mins")
- TAT > 60 mins: Count flag for orders with a TAT exceeding 60 minutes (minute-scale bucket ceiling). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT > 60 mins")
- TAT 0-6 hrs: Count flag for orders with a TAT between 0 and 6 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT 0-6 hrs")
- TAT 6-12 hrs: Count flag for orders with a TAT between 6 and 12 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT 6-12 hrs")
- TAT 12-24 hrs: Count flag for orders with a TAT between 12 and 24 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT 12-24 hrs")
- TAT 24-48 hrs: Count flag for orders with a TAT between 24 and 48 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT 24-48 hrs")
- TAT >48 hrs: Count flag for orders with a TAT exceeding 48 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT >48 hrs")
- TAT+1: Count flag for orders delivered up to 1 day beyond the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT+1")
- TAT + 2: Count flag for orders delivered up to 2 days beyond the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT + 2")
- TAT + 3: Count flag for orders delivered up to 3 days beyond the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT + 3")
- TAT + 4: Count flag for orders delivered up to 4 days beyond the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT + 4")
- TAT > 4: Count flag for orders delivered more than 4 days beyond the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT > 4")
- TAT (Same day): Count flag for orders delivered on the same calendar day as the TAT deadline. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."TAT (Same day)")
- Non F&B days diff: Elapsed days from order creation to delivery for non-F&B category orders. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Non F&B days diff")
- Shipped mark: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether a shipment dispatch record (Shipped at) exists for the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Shipped mark")
- Seller State: Indian state corresponding to the seller's pincode. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Seller State")
- Delivery State: Indian state corresponding to the delivery pincode. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Delivery State")
- Seller City: City corresponding to the seller's pincode. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Seller City")
- Delivery City: City corresponding to the delivery pincode. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Delivery City")
- Seller Tier: Metro/Tier-1/Tier-2/Tier-3 classification of the seller's city. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Seller Tier")
- Delivery Tier: Metro/Tier-1/Tier-2/Tier-3 classification of the delivery destination city. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Delivery Tier")
- Order type: Classification of the order by fulfillment type (e.g., prepaid, COD, same-day, scheduled). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Order type")
- Breach: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether the order breached its promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Breach")
- attributed_to: Party attributed responsibility for the cancellation (e.g., seller, buyer, logistics). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."attributed_to")
- reason_for_cancellation: Free-text or coded description of why the order was cancelled. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."reason_for_cancellation")
- is_triggers_rto: Flag indicating whether the cancellation initiated a Return To Origin shipment back to the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."is_triggers_rto")
- cancelled_by: Entity that triggered the cancellation action (buyer, seller, or LSP). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."cancelled_by")
- whether_applicable_for_part_cancel: Flag indicating whether the order qualifies for partial cancellation under ONDC policy. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."whether_applicable_for_part_cancel")
- sorting: Attribute used to control display or reporting sort order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."sorting")
- Buyer cancel: Count flag for orders where the cancellation was initiated by the buyer. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Buyer cancel")
- Seller cancel: Count flag for orders where the cancellation was initiated by the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Seller cancel")
- Logistic cancel: Count flag for orders where the cancellation was initiated by the Logistics Service Provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Logistic cancel")
- Cancelled att: Attribution label indicating which party (buyer, seller, or LSP) is responsible for the cancellation. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Cancelled att")
- Seller Zone: Broad geographic zone (e.g., North, South, East, West) of the seller's location. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Seller Zone")
- Delivery Zone: Broad geographic zone of the delivery destination. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Delivery Zone")
- Delivery Type: Mode or speed tier of the delivery (e.g., standard, express, same-day, hyperlocal). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm."Delivery Type")

Table: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data
Type: view

Columns:
- Date: Calendar date of the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Date")
- Seller NP: Name of the seller-side Network Participant (platform through which the seller operates). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Seller NP")
- Buyer NP: Name of the buyer-side Network Participant (platform through which the buyer placed the order). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Buyer NP")
- Network order id: Unique order identifier assigned across the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Network order id")
- provider key: Lowercase composite key (SellerNP_ProviderId) uniquely identifying a seller on a specific Network Participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."provider key")
- Provider Id: Unique identifier for the seller/provider as registered on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Provider Id")
- Seller Name: Display name of the seller or store fulfilling the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Seller Name")
- Seller Pincode: Indian postal code of the seller's location, set to null if the value is invalid or masked. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Seller Pincode")
- Delivery Pincode: Indian postal code of the delivery destination, set to null if the value is invalid or masked. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Delivery Pincode")
- cancellation_code: ONDC-standard code indicating the reason for order cancellation. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."cancellation_code")
- Created at: Timestamp when the order was originally placed on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Created at")
- Updated at: Timestamp of the most recent order status change (e.g., time of delivery or cancellation). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Updated at")
- Shipped at: Timestamp when the order was physically dispatched by the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Shipped at")
- Ready to Ship: Timestamp when the seller marked the order as packed and ready for logistics pickup. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Ready to Ship")
- Promised time: Seller-committed deadline for order delivery, used as the TAT benchmark. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Promised time")
- domain: ONDC domain the order belongs to (e.g., retail, F&B, logistics). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."domain")
- on-time-del: Flag (1/0) indicating whether the order was delivered within the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."on-time-del")
- tat_dif: Raw TAT breach indicator; 0 if delivered on time, positive value if the promised TAT was exceeded. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."tat_dif")
- tat_diff_days: TAT breach duration expressed in calendar days. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."tat_diff_days")
- day_diff: Number of calendar days elapsed between order creation and delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."day_diff")
- min_diff: Number of minutes elapsed between order creation and delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."min_diff")
- tat_time: Actual end-to-end fulfillment duration in minutes for the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."tat_time")
- Category: Product category of the order (e.g., F&B, Electronics, Fashion). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Category")
- Consolidated_category: Higher-level grouping of product category for simplified reporting. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Consolidated_category")
- ONDC order_status: Current lifecycle status of the order on the ONDC network (Delivered, Cancelled, In Process, Part Delivered). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."ONDC order_status")
- no_key: Numeric unit count per order row (typically 1), used as the base measure for aggregating order volumes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."no_key")
- Confirmed: Count of orders (equals no_key for all rows), representing total confirmed orders in the dataset. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Confirmed")
- Delivered: Count flag equal to no_key if order status is Delivered, else 0, for summing delivered order volumes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Delivered")
- Cancelled: Count flag equal to no_key if order status is Cancelled, else 0, for summing cancelled order volumes. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Cancelled")
- In Process: Count flag equal to no_key if order status is In Process, else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."In Process")
- Part Delivered: Count flag equal to no_key if order status is Part Delivered, else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Part Delivered")
- SNP: Standardized Seller NP name resolved from a reference lookup table, defaulting to 'Others' if unmapped. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."SNP")
- BNP: Standardized Buyer NP name resolved from a reference lookup table, defaulting to 'Others' if unmapped. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."BNP")
- Cancellation code cal: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether a cancellation code was recorded for the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Cancellation code cal")
- Tat breach: TAT breach value (tat_dif coalesced to 0), where any non-zero value indicates delivery exceeded the promised time. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Tat breach")
- Delivered with TAT: Count flag (no_key) for orders delivered within the promised TAT (no breach). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Delivered with TAT")
- Delivered beyond TAT: Count flag (no_key) for orders delivered after the promised TAT (TAT breached). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."Delivered beyond TAT")
- DBO: Count flag for orders where actual delivery time was on or before the promised time (Delivered By Obligation). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_open_data."DBO")

Table: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2
Type: view

Columns:
- Date: Calendar date of the order, used as the primary time dimension for reporting. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Date")
- Seller NP: Name of the seller-side Network Participant (the platform through which the seller listed the product). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Seller NP")
- Buyer NP: Name of the buyer-side Network Participant (the platform through which the buyer placed the order). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Buyer NP")
- Network order id: Unique identifier for the order shared across all participants on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Network order id")
- provider key: Surrogate key combining Seller NP and Provider Id (lowercased, underscore-joined) to uniquely identify a seller on a given platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."provider key")
- Provider Id: Unique identifier assigned to the seller or store by the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Provider Id")
- Seller Name: Display name of the seller or store fulfilling the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Seller Name")
- Seller Pincode: Indian postal code of the seller's pickup or warehouse location. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Seller Pincode")
- Delivery Pincode: Indian postal code of the buyer's delivery destination. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Delivery Pincode")
- cancellation_code: ONDC-standardised code identifying the reason category for order cancellation. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."cancellation_code")
- Created at: Timestamp when the order was first placed and confirmed on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Created at")
- Updated at: Timestamp of the most recent order status change, typically the delivery or cancellation event. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Updated at")
- Shipped at: Timestamp when the order was dispatched and handed over to logistics. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Shipped at")
- Ready to Ship: Timestamp when the seller marked the order as packed and ready for logistics pickup. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Ready to Ship")
- Promised time: Committed deadline by which the order was contractually expected to be delivered (TAT end timestamp). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Promised time")
- domain: ONDC commerce vertical the order belongs to (e.g., retail, F&B, mobility). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."domain")
- on-time-del: Binary flag (1 = on time, 0 = late) indicating whether the order was delivered within the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."on-time-del")
- tat_dif: TAT breach indicator from the base table; positive value means actual delivery exceeded promised time, zero or negative means on-time or early. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."tat_dif")
- tat_diff_days: TAT breach from the base table expressed in calendar days; positive = days overdue. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."tat_diff_days")
- day_diff: Number of calendar days elapsed between order creation and delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."day_diff")
- min_diff: Actual end-to-end delivery duration in minutes from order creation to delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."min_diff")
- tat_time: Actual TAT in minutes from order readiness to final delivery, used to compute average fulfilment speed. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."tat_time")
- Category: Product category of the order as defined on the ONDC network (e.g., F&B, Electronics, Fashion). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Category")
- Consolidated_category: Broader aggregated category grouping multiple sub-categories for simplified reporting. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Consolidated_category")
- ONDC order_status: Current lifecycle status of the order (e.g., Confirmed, In Process, Delivered, Cancelled, Part Delivered). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."ONDC order_status")
- no_key: Row-level count unit (1 per order row) used as the base additive measure for all order counts. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."no_key")
- Confirmed: Count of confirmed orders; equals no_key because every row in this view represents a confirmed order. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Confirmed")
- Delivered: Count flag set to no_key if order status is Delivered, else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Delivered")
- Cancelled: Count flag set to no_key if order status is Cancelled, else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Cancelled")
- In Process: Count flag set to no_key if order is actively in transit/processing, else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."In Process")
- Part Delivered: Count flag set to no_key if order status is Part Delivered (only a subset of items fulfilled), else 0. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Part Delivered")
- SNP: Normalised Seller Network Participant name from a reference mapping table; defaults to 'Others' for unmapped NPs. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."SNP")
- BNP: Normalised Buyer Network Participant name from a reference mapping table; defaults to 'Others' for unmapped NPs. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."BNP")

- DBO: Count of delivered orders where the actual delivery timestamp was at or before the promised time (Delivered Before or On-time by raw timestamp comparison). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."DBO")
- Breach (mins): Signed difference in minutes between actual completion time and promised time; positive = late, negative = early; for In Process orders uses current time. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Breach (mins)")
- Breach (hrs): Same TAT breach duration expressed in hours; positive = late, negative = early. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Breach (hrs)")
- Breach (days): Same TAT breach duration expressed in calendar days; positive = late, negative = early. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Breach (days)")
- Same Day: Count of delivered orders where delivery occurred on the same calendar day as order creation (day_diff = 0). (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Same Day")
- Next Day: Count of delivered orders where delivery occurred exactly one calendar day after order creation. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Next Day")
- Day + 2: Count of delivered orders where delivery occurred exactly two calendar days after order creation. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Day + 2")
- More than 2 Days: Count of delivered orders where delivery took more than two calendar days from order creation. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."More than 2 Days")
- On time deliveries: On-time delivery flag coalesced from on-time-del (0 if null), used for aggregating on-time performance metrics. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."On time deliveries")
- Average TAT (in mins): Actual TAT in minutes for delivered orders only (null for non-delivered), used to compute average fulfilment speed. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Average TAT (in mins)")
- Avg Delivery (mins): Actual end-to-end delivery duration in minutes for delivered orders with a valid positive delivery time. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."Avg Delivery (mins)")
- F&B mins diff: Total time in minutes from order creation to delivery for F&B delivered orders, reflecting full hyperlocal fulfilment duration. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."F&B mins diff")

- 30 - 45 mins: Count of F&B delivered orders fulfilled between 30 and 45 minutes of order creation. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."30 - 45 mins")
- 45 - 60 mins: Count of F&B delivered orders fulfilled between 45 and 60 minutes of order creation. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."45 - 60 mins")
- 60 - 120 mins: Count of F&B delivered orders fulfilled between 60 and 120 minutes of order creation. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."60 - 120 mins")

- TAT 24-48 hrs: Count of orders with an actual TAT between 24 and 48 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."TAT 24-48 hrs")

- TAT + 2: Count of orders delivered exactly 2 days beyond the promised TAT deadline. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."TAT + 2")
- TAT + 3: Count of orders delivered exactly 3 days beyond the promised TAT deadline. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."TAT + 3")
- TAT + 4: Count of orders delivered exactly 4 days beyond the promised TAT deadline. (Formula: analytics_insight.ordernhm_v2."TAT + 4")

- day_diff: Difference in whole calendar days between order creation and delivery (or current status update). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."day_diff")
- min_diff: Difference in minutes between two key order timestamps, typically promised vs actual delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."min_diff")
- tat_time: Actual total turn-around time from order creation to delivery, in hours or minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."tat_time")
- no_key: Surrogate integer key uniquely identifying each record in the staging table. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."no_key")
- ONDC order_status: Current lifecycle status of the order as per ONDC protocol (e.g., Created, Accepted, In-Transit, Delivered, Cancelled). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."ONDC order_status")
- Updated at: Timestamp of the most recent status update received for the order on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."Updated at")
- Category: Specific product or service category of the order as defined by the seller NP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."Category")
- Consolidated_category: Standardized rolled-up category used for cross-NP reporting and analytics. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."Consolidated_category")
- row_updated_at: Timestamp when this staging table row was last written or refreshed by the ETL pipeline. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."row_updated_at")
- network_transaction_id: Unique transaction identifier scoped to a single ONDC protocol interaction session. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."network_transaction_id")
- c_context_timestamp: Timestamp from the ONDC protocol message context, indicating when the network event was emitted. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."c_context_timestamp")
- is_force_cancelled: Flag indicating whether the order was cancelled by platform intervention rather than by buyer or seller action. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."is_force_cancelled")
- f_agent_assigned_at: Timestamp when a delivery agent (LSP field agent) was assigned to fulfill the shipment. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."f_agent_assigned_at")
- f_rto_initiated_at: Timestamp when the Return To Origin process was formally initiated by the logistics provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."f_rto_initiated_at")
- f_rto_delivered_at: Timestamp when the undeliverable shipment was successfully returned to the seller's origin location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."f_rto_delivered_at")
- f_rto_requested_at: Timestamp when the RTO request was first raised, either by the seller, buyer, or logistics provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_inc_stage."f_rto_requested_at")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm
Type: base table

Columns:
- buyer np name: Name of the Buyer Network Participant (BNP) — the buyer-side ONDC platform or app through which the consumer placed the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."buyer np name")
- seller np name: Name of the Seller Network Participant (SNP) — the seller-side ONDC platform hosting the merchant or catalog. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."seller np name")
- provider_key: Unique surrogate identifier for the seller/provider entity within the data warehouse. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."provider_key")
- item category: Product category of the ordered item as classified in the ONDC catalog taxonomy (e.g., Grocery, F&B, Fashion). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."item category")
- Order Category: High-level order classification indicating the commerce vertical or fulfillment type (e.g., retail, hyperlocal). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."Order Category")
- Seller Pincode: Indian six-digit postal code of the seller's dispatch location or warehouse from which the item is shipped. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."Seller Pincode")
- Delivery Pincode: Indian six-digit postal code of the buyer's delivery address where the order is to be fulfilled. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."Delivery Pincode")
- Date: Calendar date on which the order or order-item event was recorded in the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."Date")
- ONDC order_status: Lifecycle status of the order as reported on the ONDC network (e.g., Created, Accepted, In-Transit, Delivered, Cancelled, RTO-initiated). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."ONDC order_status")
- comp_key: Warehouse surrogate key representing the primary composite dimension grouping for this order-item record, used for joins and partitioning. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."comp_key")
- comp-subkey: Secondary sub-level surrogate key providing finer granularity within a comp_key group, enabling drill-down aggregation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."comp-subkey")
- noi_key: Surrogate key uniquely identifying a Network Order Item (NOI) — a single line item within an ONDC order across the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm."noi_key")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv
Type: view

Columns:
- buyer np name: Name of the Buyer Network Participant (BNP) — the ONDC-registered platform through which the buyer placed the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."buyer np name")
- seller np name: Name of the Seller Network Participant (SNP) — the ONDC-registered platform through which the seller listed and fulfilled the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."seller np name")
- provider_key: Unique identifier for the seller or provider entity within the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."provider_key")
- item category: Granular item-level sub-category of the ordered product (e.g., 'Men's T-Shirts' within Apparel). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."item category")
- Order Category: Broad top-level product category of the order (e.g., Grocery, Fashion, Electronics). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Order Category")
- Seller Pincode: Six-digit Indian postal (pin) code of the seller's dispatch location or warehouse. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Seller Pincode")
- Delivery Pincode: Six-digit Indian postal (pin) code of the buyer's delivery address. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Delivery Pincode")
- Date: Calendar date on which the order event or transaction was recorded. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Date")
- ONDC order_status: Current lifecycle status of the order on the ONDC network (e.g., Confirmed, Delivered, In Process, Cancelled). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."ONDC order_status")
- comp_key: Base numeric weight representing one countable category-level order unit; used as the additive count metric at the Order Category grain. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."comp_key")
- comp-subkey: Numeric weight representing one countable sub-category-level order unit; used as the additive count metric at the item-category grain. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."comp-subkey")
- noi_key: Number-of-items key — numeric weight representing the count of individual line items within the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."noi_key")
- Confirmed Category: Category-level count for all confirmed orders, regardless of subsequent status (equals comp_key unconditionally). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Confirmed Category")
- Confirmed Items: Item-level count for all confirmed orders, regardless of subsequent status (equals noi_key unconditionally). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Confirmed Items")
- Confirmed Sub-Category: Sub-category-level count for all confirmed orders, regardless of subsequent status (equals comp-subkey unconditionally). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Confirmed Sub-Category")
- Conf Cat: Best-available-granularity confirmed count — uses sub-category weight (comp-subkey) when both Order Category and item category are known, otherwise falls back to category weight (comp_key). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Conf Cat")
- Delivered Category: Category-level count of orders that reached Delivered status; zero for all other statuses, enabling direct SUM aggregation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Delivered Category")
- Delivered Items: Item-level count of orders that reached Delivered status; zero for all other statuses. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Delivered Items")
- Delivered Sub-Category: Sub-category-level count of orders that reached Delivered status; zero for all other statuses. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Delivered Sub-Category")
- Del Cat: Best-available-granularity delivered count — uses sub-category weight when both category dimensions are present, otherwise uses category weight; zero for non-Delivered rows. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Del Cat")
- In Process Category: Category-level count of orders currently In Process (accepted but not yet delivered or cancelled); zero for all other statuses. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."In Process Category")
- In Process Items: Item-level count of orders currently In Process; zero for all other statuses. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."In Process Items")
- In Process Sub-Category: Sub-category-level count of orders currently In Process; zero for all other statuses. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."In Process Sub-Category")
- In proc Cat: Best-available-granularity in-process count — uses sub-category weight when both category dimensions are present, otherwise category weight; zero for non-In-Process rows. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."In proc Cat")
- Cancelled Category: Category-level count of orders that were Cancelled; zero for all other statuses. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Cancelled Category")
- Cancelled Items: Item-level count of orders that were Cancelled; zero for all other statuses. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Cancelled Items")
- Cancelled Sub-Category: Sub-category-level count of orders that were Cancelled; zero for all other statuses. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Cancelled Sub-Category")
- Cancl Cat: Best-available-granularity cancelled count — uses sub-category weight when both category dimensions are present, otherwise category weight; zero for non-Cancelled rows. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Cancl Cat")
- Seller State: Indian state name of the seller's dispatch location, resolved from the seller pincode via the pincode dimension table. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Seller State")
- Delivery State: Indian state name of the buyer's delivery address, resolved from the delivery pincode via the pincode dimension table. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Delivery State")
- Seller City: District or city name of the seller's dispatch location, resolved from the seller pincode via the pincode dimension table. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Seller City")
- Delivery City: District or city name of the buyer's delivery address, resolved from the delivery pincode via the pincode dimension table. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_bv."Delivery City")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage
Type: base table

Columns:
- buyer np name: Name of the Buyer Network Participant (the buyer-side app/platform on ONDC through which the order was placed) (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."buyer np name")
- seller np name: Name of the Seller Network Participant (the seller-side app/platform on ONDC through which the seller listed their products) (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."seller np name")
- provider_key: Unique identifier for the seller or store (provider entity) within the ONDC network (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."provider_key")
- item category: Product sub-category of the ordered item as catalogued on ONDC (e.g., Fruits, Vegetables, Dairy) (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."item category")
- Order Category: High-level order fulfillment classification indicating the order type or delivery mode (e.g., Home Delivery, Self-Pickup) (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."Order Category")
- Seller Pincode: Indian postal code of the seller's warehouse or pickup location from which the order was fulfilled (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."Seller Pincode")
- Delivery Pincode: Indian postal code of the buyer's delivery address to which the order was shipped (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."Delivery Pincode")
- Date: Calendar date on which the order transaction or status event occurred (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."Date")
- ONDC order_status: Current lifecycle status of the order on the ONDC network (e.g., Created, Accepted, In-Transit, Delivered, Cancelled, RTO) (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."ONDC order_status")
- comp_key: Surrogate key identifying the complaint or compliance record associated with the order in the grievance tracking system (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."comp_key")

- noi_key: Surrogate key representing the Nature of Issue (NOI) raised against the order in the ONDC grievance or dispute resolution system (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_itemnhm_stage."noi_key")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv
Type: view

Columns:
- Date: Calendar date on which the order was placed. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Date")
- Seller NP: Full name of the Seller Network Participant — the platform through which the seller operates on ONDC. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Seller NP")
- Buyer NP: Full name of the Buyer Network Participant — the app or platform the buyer used to place the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Buyer NP")
- Network order id: Unique order identifier assigned by the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Network order id")
- provider key: Lowercase composite key (seller_np + provider_id) used to uniquely identify a seller-provider combination across the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."provider key")
- Provider Id: Unique identifier for the seller or store (provider) on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Provider Id")
- Seller Name: Display name of the seller or store fulfilling the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Seller Name")
- Seller Pincode: Indian postal code (pincode) of the seller's pickup or store location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Seller Pincode")
- Delivery Pincode: Indian postal code of the buyer's delivery address. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivery Pincode")
- cancellation_code: ONDC-defined code indicating the specific reason an order was cancelled. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."cancellation_code")
- Created at: Timestamp when the order was created on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Created at")
- Updated at: Timestamp of the most recent status update to the order, typically reflecting the final state change. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Updated at")
- Updated: Date portion of the last order status update timestamp. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Updated")
- Shipped at: Timestamp when the order was handed over to logistics and marked as shipped. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Shipped at")
- Ready to Ship: Timestamp when the seller marked the order as packed and ready for pickup by the LSP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Ready to Ship")
- Promised time: Promised delivery deadline (TAT commitment) agreed at order creation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Promised time")
- domain: ONDC network domain under which the order was placed (e.g., retail, F&B). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."domain")
- on-time-del: Binary float flag (1.0 = on time, 0.0 = late) indicating whether the order was delivered within the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."on-time-del")
- tat_dif: Signed difference between actual delivery time and the promised TAT; positive values indicate a late delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."tat_dif")
- tat_diff_days: TAT breach or buffer expressed in fractional days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."tat_diff_days")
- day_diff: Number of calendar days elapsed between order creation date and delivery date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."day_diff")
- min_diff: Number of minutes elapsed between order creation and delivery, used primarily for F&B TAT analysis. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."min_diff")
- tat_time: Promised TAT duration for the order (typically in hours), as committed at order creation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."tat_time")
- Category: Primary product category of the order (e.g., F&B, Electronics, Fashion). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Category")
- Consolidated_category: Broader grouped category used for cross-domain reporting and benchmarking. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Consolidated_category")
- ONDC order_status: Current lifecycle status of the order on the ONDC network (e.g., Delivered, Cancelled, In Process, Part Delivered). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."ONDC order_status")
- no_key: Row-level count key, always 1 per order row, used as the base unit for summing order counts in aggregations. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."no_key")
- Confirmed: Count indicator (equals no_key = 1) representing that the order was confirmed; every row in this view is a confirmed order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Confirmed")
- Delivered: Count indicator (1 if status = Delivered, else 0) for summing delivered order counts. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivered")
- Cancelled: Count indicator (1 if status = Cancelled, else 0) for summing cancelled order counts. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Cancelled")
- In Process: Count indicator (1 if status = In Process, else 0) for summing orders currently being processed. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."In Process")
- Part Delivered: Count indicator (1 if status = Part Delivered, else 0) for summing partially delivered order counts. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Part Delivered")
- SNP: Short code or abbreviated identifier for the Seller Network Participant, defaulting to 'Others' if not mapped. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."SNP")
- BNP: Short code or abbreviated identifier for the Buyer Network Participant, defaulting to 'Others' if not mapped. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."BNP")
- Cancellation code cal: Binary flag (1 if a cancellation code is present, else 0) indicating the order has a recorded cancellation reason. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Cancellation code cal")
- Delivered with TAT: Count indicator for delivered orders that met the promised TAT (tat_dif = 0, i.e., on time or early). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivered with TAT")
- Delivered beyond TAT: Count indicator for delivered orders that exceeded the promised TAT (tat_dif > 0, i.e., late). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivered beyond TAT")
- DBO: Count indicator for delivered orders where the actual delivery timestamp was at or before the promised time (Delivered Before or On-time). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."DBO")
- Delivered beyond P.TAT: Count indicator for delivered orders (from 1 Nov 2023 onward) where the delivery date was strictly after the promised TAT date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivered beyond P.TAT")
- Delivered within P.TAT: Count indicator for delivered orders (from 1 Nov 2023 onward) where the delivery date was on or before the promised TAT date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivered within P.TAT")
- Breach (mins): Signed time difference in minutes between actual resolution time and the promised TAT; positive = late, negative = early; uses current time for In Process orders. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Breach (mins)")
- Breach (hrs): Same TAT breach measurement as 'Breach (mins)' expressed in hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Breach (hrs)")
- Breach (days): Same TAT breach measurement as 'Breach (mins)' expressed in days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Breach (days)")
- Same Day: Count indicator for delivered orders that were delivered on the same calendar day they were placed (day_diff = 0). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Same Day")
- Next Day: Count indicator for delivered orders delivered exactly one calendar day after placement (day_diff = 1). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Next Day")
- Day + 2: Count indicator for delivered orders delivered exactly two calendar days after placement (day_diff = 2). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Day + 2")
- More than 2 Days: Count indicator for delivered orders that took more than two calendar days from placement to delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."More than 2 Days")
- On time deliveries: on-time-del value coalesced to 0; used as a summable numeric indicator of on-time deliveries in aggregations. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."On time deliveries")
- F&B mins diff: Actual end-to-end delivery duration in minutes (creation to delivery) for F&B category delivered orders. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."F&B mins diff")
- Within 15 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders completed within 15 minutes of placement. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Within 15 mins")
- 15 - 30 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders completed between 15 and 30 minutes of placement. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."15 - 30 mins")
- 30 - 45 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders completed between 30 and 45 minutes of placement. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."30 - 45 mins")
- 45 - 60 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders completed between 45 and 60 minutes of placement. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."45 - 60 mins")
- 60 - 120 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders completed between 60 and 120 minutes of placement. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."60 - 120 mins")
- Above 120 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders taking more than 120 minutes from placement to delivery. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Above 120 mins")
- TAT < 5 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT of under 5 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT < 5 mins")
- TAT 5-15 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT between 5 and 15 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT 5-15 mins")
- TAT 15-30 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT between 15 and 30 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT 15-30 mins")
- TAT 30-60 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT between 30 and 60 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT 30-60 mins")
- TAT > 60 mins: Count indicator for F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT exceeding 60 minutes. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT > 60 mins")
- TAT 0-6 hrs: Count indicator for non-F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT between 0 and 6 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT 0-6 hrs")
- TAT 6-12 hrs: Count indicator for non-F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT between 6 and 12 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT 6-12 hrs")
- TAT 12-24 hrs: Count indicator for non-F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT between 12 and 24 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT 12-24 hrs")
- TAT 24-48 hrs: Count indicator for non-F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT between 24 and 48 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT 24-48 hrs")
- TAT >48 hrs: Count indicator for non-F&B delivered orders with a promised TAT exceeding 48 hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT >48 hrs")
- TAT+1: Count indicator for delivered orders that arrived exactly 1 day beyond the promised TAT date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT+1")
- TAT + 2: Count indicator for delivered orders that arrived exactly 2 days beyond the promised TAT date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT + 2")
- TAT + 3: Count indicator for delivered orders that arrived exactly 3 days beyond the promised TAT date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT + 3")
- TAT + 4: Count indicator for delivered orders that arrived exactly 4 days beyond the promised TAT date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT + 4")
- TAT > 4: Count indicator for delivered orders that arrived more than 4 days beyond the promised TAT date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT > 4")
- TAT (Same day): Count indicator for delivered orders delivered on the same calendar day as the promised TAT date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."TAT (Same day)")
- Non F&B days diff: Fractional days from order creation to delivery for non-F&B delivered orders, used for TAT bucketing. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Non F&B days diff")
- Shipped mark: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether the order has been marked as shipped by the seller or LSP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Shipped mark")
- Seller State: Indian state in which the seller's pickup location is situated. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Seller State")
- Delivery State: Indian state of the buyer's delivery address. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivery State")
- Seller City: City where the seller's pickup or store location is situated. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Seller City")
- Delivery City: City of the buyer's delivery address. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivery City")
- Seller Tier: Tier classification of the seller's city (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Tier 3) based on population or commerce ranking. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Seller Tier")
- Delivery Tier: Tier classification of the delivery destination city. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivery Tier")
- Seller Zone: Broad geographic zone (e.g., North, South, East, West) of the seller's location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Seller Zone")
- Delivery Zone: Broad geographic zone of the buyer's delivery address. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivery Zone")
- Delivery Type: Classification of the delivery route (e.g., intra-city, inter-city, inter-state) based on seller and delivery locations. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Delivery Type")
- Order type: Classification of the order's commerce type (e.g., B2C, social commerce). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Order type")
- Breach: Binary flag (1 = TAT breached, 0 = within TAT) indicating whether the order violated its promised delivery deadline. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Breach")
- Inprocessnew(tat): Count of In Process orders (under a revised definition) that have already exceeded their promised TAT as of the current time. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Inprocessnew(tat)")
- inprocess(tat): Count of In Process orders (original definition) that have already exceeded their promised TAT as of the current time. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."inprocess(tat)")
- Buyer cancelled(tat): Count of buyer-cancelled orders where the TAT had already been breached at the time of cancellation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Buyer cancelled(tat)")
- Logistics cancelled(tat): Count of logistics-cancelled orders where the TAT had already been breached at the time of cancellation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Logistics cancelled(tat)")
- attributed_to: Party attributed responsibility for the cancellation (e.g., buyer, seller, logistics provider). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."attributed_to")
- reason_for_cancellation: Free-text or coded reason describing why the order was cancelled. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."reason_for_cancellation")
- is_triggers_rto: Flag indicating whether this order triggered a Return To Origin (RTO) shipment back to the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."is_triggers_rto")
- cancelled_by: Entity that initiated the cancellation action — buyer, seller, or logistics service provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."cancelled_by")
- whether_applicable_for_part_cancel: Flag indicating whether the order is eligible for partial cancellation under ONDC policy. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."whether_applicable_for_part_cancel")
- sorting: Auxiliary field used to control display sort order in dashboards or reports. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."sorting")
- Buyer Cancel: Count indicator (1 if cancelled by buyer, else 0) for summing buyer-initiated cancellations. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Buyer Cancel")
- Seller Cancel: Count indicator (1 if cancelled by seller, else 0) for summing seller-initiated cancellations. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Seller Cancel")
- Logistics Cancel: Count indicator (1 if cancelled by the logistics provider, else 0) for summing LSP-initiated cancellations. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Logistics Cancel")
- Cancelled att: Attribution label for the cancellation, indicating which party (buyer, seller, logistics) is held responsible. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Cancelled att")
- In Process (Dt): Count indicator for orders that were in the In Process state on the record date. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."In Process (Dt)")
- delivered(tat): Count indicator for delivered orders that were fulfilled within the promised TAT. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."delivered(tat)")
- Social Cred Orders: Count indicator for orders placed via social commerce or social credibility channels on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."Social Cred Orders")
- network_transaction_id: Unique transaction identifier at the ONDC network level, linking all messages in an order lifecycle. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."network_transaction_id")
- f_agent_assigned_at: Timestamp when a delivery agent was assigned to the order by the logistics service provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."f_agent_assigned_at")
- f_rto_initiated_at: Timestamp when the Return To Origin process was formally initiated for an undeliverable or rejected order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."f_rto_initiated_at")
- f_rto_delivered_at: Timestamp when the returned shipment was successfully delivered back to the seller under RTO. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."f_rto_delivered_at")
- f_rto_requested_at: Timestamp when an RTO was first requested, typically by the buyer or LSP before formal initiation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_b2c_ordernhm_bv."f_rto_requested_at")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv
Type: view

Columns:
- Created At: Timestamp when the error event was recorded in the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Created At")
- Domain: ONDC domain category under which the transaction occurred (e.g., retail, grocery, mobility). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Domain")
- Order Level: Granularity level within the order at which the error occurred (e.g., item, fulfillment, order). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Order Level")
- Action: ONDC API callback or request action that returned the error (e.g., on_select, on_confirm, init). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Action")
- Base_action: Parent or originating action that triggered the corresponding callback action carrying the error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Base_action")
- Bap ID: Unique network identifier of the Buyer Application Platform (buyer-side network participant) involved in the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Bap ID")
- Buyer NP: Human-readable name of the buyer network participant resolved from the BAP ID dimension table. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Buyer NP")
- Bpp ID: Unique network identifier of the Buyer-side Provider Platform (seller-side network participant) involved in the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Bpp ID")
- Seller NP: Human-readable name of the seller network participant resolved from the BPP ID dimension table. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Seller NP")
- BPP Title: Dashboard display heading for seller NP drill-down analysis, showing BPP ID or 'OVERALL' when no specific seller NP is filtered. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."BPP Title")
- BAP Title: Dashboard display heading for buyer NP drill-down analysis, showing BAP ID or 'OVERALL' when no specific buyer NP is filtered. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."BAP Title")
- BPP Subtitle: Short display label combining BPP ID with a '(Seller NP)' suffix for chart subtitles, or 'Overall(Seller NP)' in aggregate views. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."BPP Subtitle")
- BAP Subtitle: Short display label combining BAP ID with a '(Buyer NP)' suffix for chart subtitles, or 'Overall(Buyer NP)' in aggregate views. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."BAP Subtitle")
- Title for KPI: KPI card heading indicating the confirmation attempt date formatted as 'Attempt to Confirm on DD Mon YY'. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Title for KPI")
- Provider ID: Unique identifier of the individual seller or provider catalog entity on the seller network participant's platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Provider ID")
- Error Code: Standardised ONDC error code returned in the API response identifying the category of failure. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Error Code")
- Message: Short human-readable error message mapped from the error code via the error code category dimension. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Message")
- Error Description: Detailed explanation of the error code's business meaning sourced from the error code category dimension. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Error Description")
- Count: Raw count of error occurrences for this action–error code–participant combination in the given time period. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Count")
- Mcount: Secondary error count, typically representing a deduplicated or merchant-scoped variant of the raw error count for cross-validation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Mcount")
- on_select: Error count attributable to on_select callbacks; zero when the row's action is any other type. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."on_select")
- on_init: Error count attributable to on_init callbacks; zero when the row's action is any other type. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."on_init")
- on_confirm: Error count attributable to on_confirm callbacks; zero when the row's action is any other type. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."on_confirm")
- on_status: Error count attributable to on_status callbacks; zero when the row's action is any other type. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."on_status")
- on_cancel: Error count attributable to on_cancel callbacks; zero when the row's action is any other type. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."on_cancel")
- confirm: Error count attributable to confirm request actions; zero when the row's action is any other type. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."confirm")
- init: Error count attributable to init request actions; zero when the row's action is any other type. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."init")
- Total Errors: Total error count for the row, equivalent to Count but null-safe (defaults to zero when Count is null). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_error_bv."Total Errors")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv
Type: view

Columns:
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the Seller Network Participant (BPP – Beckn Provider Platform) on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."bpp_id")
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the Buyer Network Participant (BAP – Beckn Application Platform) on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."bap_id")
- domain: ONDC retail sub-domain or category (e.g., Grocery, F&B) to which the transaction belongs. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."domain")
- transaction_id: Unique ONDC session ID linking all API calls (select → on_confirm) for a single buyer-seller interaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."transaction_id")
- provider_id: Identifier of the individual seller or store registered on the BPP platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."provider_id")
- order_status: Final lifecycle status of the order (e.g., Delivered, Cancelled, In Process). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."order_status")
- cancellation_type: Category indicating who initiated cancellation and the stated reason (Buyer, Seller, Logistics, etc.). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."cancellation_type")
- seller_pincode: Indian postal (PIN) code of the seller's fulfillment or warehouse location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."seller_pincode")
- provider_name: Display name of the seller or store as registered on the BPP platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."provider_name")
- delivery_pincode: Indian postal (PIN) code of the buyer's delivery destination. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."delivery_pincode")
- is_error: Flag ('yes'/'no') indicating whether any ONDC API error occurred during the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."is_error")
- error_code: Specific ONDC protocol error code returned in an API response during the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."error_code")
- first_seen_date: Calendar date on which the transaction's first API call was observed. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."first_seen_date")
- hour_of_day: Hour of day (0–23) when the transaction's first API call was received, used for time-of-day analysis. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."hour_of_day")
- min_trans_type_sp: Numeric code of the earliest ONDC API call step reached in the transaction (1 = /select). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."min_trans_type_sp")
- max_trans_type_sp: Numeric code of the furthest ONDC API call step reached in the transaction (1=/select … 6=/on_confirm), representing funnel depth. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."max_trans_type_sp")
- max_error_trans_type_sp: Numeric code of the most advanced API call step at which an error was recorded in the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."max_error_trans_type_sp")
- end_trans_type: The final API call type that concluded the transaction (e.g., 'confirm', 'on_select'). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."end_trans_type")
- qsr: Flag indicating whether the seller is classified as a Quick Service Restaurant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."qsr")
- Seller NP: Human-readable name of the Seller Network Participant (BPP) platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Seller NP")
- Buyer NP: Human-readable name of the Buyer Network Participant (BAP) platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Buyer NP")
- Call Type: Whether buyer and seller are on the same NP platform ('Intra NP') or different platforms ('Inter NP'). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Call Type")
- error_category: Business classification of the error encountered in the transaction (Logistics, Merchant Not Available, Inventory, Others). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."error_category")
- provider_key: Composite unique key (bpp_id + provider_id) to globally identify a specific seller across the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."provider_key")
- Select: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the transaction initiated a /select API call, marking funnel entry. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Select")
- on_select: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the BPP returned an /on_select response (funnel step 2 reached). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."on_select")
- Init: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the buyer sent an /init API call to begin order initialisation (step 3 reached). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Init")
- on_init: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the BPP returned an /on_init response with order terms (step 4 reached). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."on_init")
- Confirm_: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the buyer sent a /confirm request to place the order (step 5 reached). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Confirm_")
- on_confirm: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the BPP returned an /on_confirm acknowledgement (step 6 reached). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."on_confirm")
- Confirm: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a clean successful order confirmation: reached on_confirm with no error recorded at that step. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Confirm")
