- Select to Delivered: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the transaction entered at Select and the order was ultimately Delivered. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Select to Delivered")
- Select to Cancelled: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the transaction entered at Select but the order was ultimately Cancelled. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Select to Cancelled")
- Confirm to inprocess: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a confirmed order whose current status is In Process (fulfillment started). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Confirm to inprocess")
- Confirm to Delivered: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a confirmed order that reached Delivered status. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Confirm to Delivered")
- In Process: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a confirmed order currently in the In Process fulfillment stage. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."In Process")
- On_Select Error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the transaction encountered an error at or before the on_select step (step ≤ 2). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."On_Select Error")
- On_Confirm Error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the transaction encountered an error at the Confirm or on_confirm step (steps 5–6). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."On_Confirm Error")
- Drop not due to Error (Select-Init) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction stalled at on_select without progressing to Init and with no error present (organic/non-error drop). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop not due to Error (Select-Init) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Select-Init) (logistics) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped between Select and Init specifically due to a Logistics-category error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (Select-Init) (logistics) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Select-Init) (merchant) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped between Select and Init due to a Merchant Not Available error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (Select-Init) (merchant) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Select-Init) (inventory) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped between Select and Init due to an Inventory error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (Select-Init) (inventory) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Select-Init) (others) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped between Select and Init due to an Others-category error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (Select-Init) (others) absolute")
- Drop not due to Error (Init-Confirm) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction stalled at on_init without progressing to Confirm and with no error present (organic drop). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop not due to Error (Init-Confirm) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (logistics) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped between Init and Confirm due to a Logistics error occurring at the furthest step reached. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (logistics) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (merchant) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped between Init and Confirm due to a Merchant Not Available error at the furthest step reached. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (merchant) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Confirm-on_confirm) (logistics) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped between Confirm and on_confirm due to a Logistics error at the furthest step reached. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (Confirm-on_confirm) (logistics) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (others) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped anywhere in the Select-to-Confirm funnel due to an Others-category error at the furthest step reached. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (others) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (logistics) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped anywhere in the Select-to-Confirm funnel due to a Logistics error at the furthest step reached. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (logistics) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (merchant) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped anywhere in the Select-to-Confirm funnel due to a Merchant Not Available error at the furthest step reached. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (merchant) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Select-Confirm) (inventory) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped anywhere in the Select-to-Confirm funnel due to an Inventory error at the furthest step reached. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (Select-Confirm) (inventory) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (inventory) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped between Init and Confirm due to an Inventory error at the furthest step reached. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (inventory) absolute")
- Drop not due to Error (Select-Confirm) absolute: Binary flag (1/0): transaction dropped somewhere in the full Select-to-Confirm funnel with no error present (organic non-error drop across any pre-confirm step). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Drop not due to Error (Select-Confirm) absolute")
- Cancelled (Select - Seller): Binary flag (1/0) indicating a post-confirm order that was cancelled by the Seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Cancelled (Select - Seller)")
- Cancelled (Select - Buyer): Binary flag (1/0) indicating a post-confirm order that was cancelled by the Buyer. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Cancelled (Select - Buyer)")
- Cancelled (Select - Logistics): Binary flag (1/0) indicating a post-confirm order that was cancelled due to a Logistics issue. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Cancelled (Select - Logistics)")
- Seller State: Indian state derived from the seller's PIN code, used for geographic segmentation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Seller State")
- Delivery State: Indian state derived from the delivery PIN code, used for geographic segmentation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Delivery State")
- Seller City: City derived from the seller's PIN code. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Seller City")
- Delivery City: City derived from the delivery PIN code. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Delivery City")
- Seller Tier: Tier classification (Tier 1/2/3) of the seller's city based on population or market size. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Seller Tier")
- Delivery Tier: Tier classification (Tier 1/2/3) of the delivery destination city. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Delivery Tier")
- Seller Zone: Broad geographic zone (e.g., North, South, East, West) of the seller's location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Seller Zone")
- Delivery Zone: Broad geographic zone of the delivery destination. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_bv."Delivery Zone")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2
Type: base table

Columns:
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the Beckn Provider Platform (seller-side network participant) involved in the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."bpp_id")
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the Beckn Application Platform (buyer-side network participant) that originated the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."bap_id")
- domain: ONDC sector/vertical of the transaction (e.g., retail grocery, F&B, fashion). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."domain")
- transaction_id: Unique end-to-end ONDC session identifier linking all API calls for a single buyer journey. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."transaction_id")
- provider_id: Unique identifier of the merchant or seller as registered on the BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."provider_id")
- order_status: Final or current lifecycle state of the order (e.g., Created, Accepted, Cancelled, Completed). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."order_status")
- cancellation_type: Indicates who initiated cancellation — buyer, seller, or system — and the reason category. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."cancellation_type")
- seller_pincode: Indian postal code of the seller's store or fulfilment location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."seller_pincode")
- provider_name: Brand or merchant name of the seller as published on the BPP catalog. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."provider_name")
- delivery_pincode: Indian postal code of the buyer's requested delivery address. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."delivery_pincode")
- is_error: Flag indicating whether the transaction encountered at least one ONDC protocol error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."is_error")
- error_code: ONDC-standard error code returned at the failing stage of the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."error_code")
- txn_timestamp: Timestamp of the primary transaction event captured in the funnel. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."txn_timestamp")
- first_seen_date: Date the transaction was first ingested into the data warehouse. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."first_seen_date")
- hour_of_day: Hour of day (0–23) extracted from the transaction timestamp for time-of-day analysis. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."hour_of_day")
- min_trans_type_sp: Numeric code of the earliest transaction stage reached on the seller platform in this session. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."min_trans_type_sp")
- max_trans_type_sp: Numeric code of the furthest transaction stage reached on the seller platform in this session. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."max_trans_type_sp")
- max_error_trans_type_sp: Numeric code of the transaction stage at which the most downstream error occurred on the seller platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."max_error_trans_type_sp")
- end_trans_type: Final ONDC API stage at which the transaction terminated (e.g., search, select, init, confirm). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."end_trans_type")
- dropped_due_to_error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was abandoned because of an error rather than buyer intent. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."dropped_due_to_error")
- qsr: Flag indicating whether the provider is classified as a Quick Service Restaurant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."qsr")
- error_type_flag: Categorical label classifying the root-cause error type (e.g., inventory, serviceability, logistics, merchant). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."error_type_flag")
- error_context_ts_ist: Timestamp in IST at which the error context was recorded or the error event occurred. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."error_context_ts_ist")
- provider_location_id: Unique identifier of the seller's specific physical store or outlet on the BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."provider_location_id")
- provider_order_timings: Operating hours or order-acceptance window as configured by the provider in their catalog. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."provider_order_timings")
- provider_last_on_search_type: Search event type during which the provider was last observed as active on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."provider_last_on_search_type")
- provider_last_status_on_search_id: Search session ID associated with the provider's most recent known status event. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."provider_last_status_on_search_id")
- provider_last_status_timestamp: Timestamp of the provider's most recent availability or operational status update on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."provider_last_status_timestamp")
- provider_last_status: Most recent operational status of the provider as seen on the network (e.g., enabled, disabled). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."provider_last_status")
- error_store_timing_flag: Flag indicating whether the error coincides with the store being outside its configured operating hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."error_store_timing_flag")
- buyer_attributed_merchant_error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a merchant-category error where buyer behavior is the root cause. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."buyer_attributed_merchant_error")
- seller_attributed_merchant_error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a merchant-category error where the seller or provider is the root cause. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."seller_attributed_merchant_error")
- store_error_diff_mins: Minutes elapsed between the store's last status update and the error occurrence, used to assess staleness. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."store_error_diff_mins")
- store_error_diff_hours: Hours elapsed between the store's last status update and the error occurrence. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."store_error_diff_hours")
- store_error_recency_flag: Categorical label classifying how recent the store's last status change was relative to when the error occurred. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."store_error_recency_flag")
- pc_item_name: Name of the catalog item involved in or relevant to the transaction error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."pc_item_name")
- item_id: Unique identifier of the catalog item on the BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."item_id")
- item_type: Classification of the catalog entry (e.g., item, variant, customisation). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."item_type")
- custom_menu_name: Name of the custom menu section or category grouping the item on the seller's catalog. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."custom_menu_name")
- custom_menu_id: Unique identifier of the custom menu or category the item belongs to. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."custom_menu_id")
- pc_item_label: Display label or badge associated with the item in the product catalog (e.g., veg, non-veg, bestseller). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."pc_item_label")
- pc_item_available_quantity: Stock or quantity of the item as last published in the seller's product catalog. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."pc_item_available_quantity")
- item_last_on_search_type: Search event type during which this item was last seen as available on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."item_last_on_search_type")
- item_last_transaction: Identifier or stage of the most recent transaction that involved this item. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."item_last_transaction")
- item_last_status_timestamp: Timestamp of the most recent availability status update published for this item. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."item_last_status_timestamp")
- item_last_status: Most recent availability state of the item as seen on the network (e.g., in_stock, out_of_stock). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."item_last_status")
- error_item_timing_flag: Flag indicating whether the error correlates with item-level availability or timing issues. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."error_item_timing_flag")
- error_menu_timing_flag: Flag indicating whether the error correlates with menu-level availability or operating-time issues. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."error_menu_timing_flag")
- buyer_attributed_inventory_error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating an inventory error where the buyer's request (e.g., stale cart) is the root cause. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."buyer_attributed_inventory_error")
- seller_attributed_inventory_error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating an inventory error where the seller's catalog or stock management is the root cause. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."seller_attributed_inventory_error")
- item_error_diff_mins: Minutes elapsed between the item's last status update and the error, used to assess catalog staleness. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."item_error_diff_mins")
- item_error_diff_hours: Hours elapsed between the item's last status update and the error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."item_error_diff_hours")
- item_error_recency_flag: Categorical label classifying how recent the item's last status change was relative to the error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."item_error_recency_flag")
- pc_delivery_gps: GPS coordinates (latitude, longitude) of the buyer's delivery address as submitted in the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."pc_delivery_gps")
- is_valid_gps: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether the delivery GPS coordinates are parseable and within valid geographic ranges. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."is_valid_gps")
- is_valid_pincode: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether the delivery pincode is a structurally valid Indian postal code. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."is_valid_pincode")
- is_within_india: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether the delivery GPS coordinates fall within India's geographic boundary. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."is_within_india")
- serviceability_type_label: Label describing the method used to assess delivery serviceability (e.g., pincode list, geofence polygon, radius). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."serviceability_type_label")
- serviceability_verifiability: Indicates whether the seller's serviceability claim can be independently verified using available data. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."serviceability_verifiability")
- provider_location_serviceability_unit: Granularity unit at which the seller's serviceability is defined for this location (e.g., pincode, polygon, circle). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."provider_location_serviceability_unit")
- geojson_type: GeoJSON geometry type used for the seller's serviceability boundary (e.g., Polygon, MultiPolygon). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."geojson_type")
- geojson_status: Quality status of the seller's GeoJSON serviceability data (e.g., valid, missing, malformed). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."geojson_status")
- geo_json_shared: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether the seller has published a GeoJSON boundary for their serviceability area. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."geo_json_shared")
- delivery_within_geofence: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether the buyer's delivery GPS falls inside the seller's GeoJSON serviceability polygon. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."delivery_within_geofence")
- within_pincode_fence: Binary flag (1/0) indicating whether the buyer's delivery pincode is in the seller's serviceable pincode list. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."within_pincode_fence")
- buyer_attributed_serviceability_error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a serviceability error caused by the buyer's address being outside any serviceable zone. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."buyer_attributed_serviceability_error")
- seller_attributed_serviceability_error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a serviceability error caused by incorrect, missing, or misconfigured seller serviceability data. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."seller_attributed_serviceability_error")
- unknown_attributed_serviceability_error: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a serviceability error where attribution to buyer or seller cannot be determined. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."unknown_attributed_serviceability_error")
- buyer_attributed_logistics: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a logistics failure attributable to the buyer (e.g., wrong address, recipient unavailable). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."buyer_attributed_logistics")
- lsp_attributed_logistics: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a logistics failure attributable to the Logistics Service Provider (e.g., delivery agent no-show). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."lsp_attributed_logistics")
- seller_attributed_logistics: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a logistics failure attributable to the seller (e.g., order not ready, packaging failure). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."seller_attributed_logistics")
- buyer_others_attributed: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a miscellaneous non-inventory, non-serviceability, non-logistics error attributable to the buyer. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."buyer_others_attributed")
- seller_others_attributed: Binary flag (1/0) indicating a miscellaneous non-inventory, non-serviceability, non-logistics error attributable to the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."seller_others_attributed")
- overall_buyer_attributed: Composite binary flag (1/0) indicating the buyer is responsible for at least one error across all error categories in this transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."overall_buyer_attributed")
- overall_seller_attributed: Composite binary flag (1/0) indicating the seller is responsible for at least one error across all error categories in this transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."overall_seller_attributed")
- overall_lsp_attributed: Composite binary flag (1/0) indicating the LSP is responsible for at least one error across all error categories in this transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."overall_lsp_attributed")
- overall_unknown_attributed: Composite binary flag (1/0) indicating at least one error in this transaction could not be attributed to any identified party. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2."overall_unknown_attributed")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv
Type: view

Columns:
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the Seller-side (BPP) Network Participant on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."bpp_id")
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the Buyer-side (BAP) Network Participant on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."bap_id")
- domain: ONDC domain category of the transaction (e.g., retail grocery, food and beverage). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."domain")
- transaction_id: Unique identifier for the end-to-end ONDC order transaction lifecycle. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."transaction_id")
- provider_id: Unique identifier of the specific seller/merchant within the BPP platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."provider_id")
- order_status: Current lifecycle status of the order (e.g., delivered, cancelled, in-process). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."order_status")
- cancellation_type: Party responsible for the cancellation — buyer, seller, or logistics. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."cancellation_type")
- seller_pincode: Indian postal code of the seller/merchant's location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."seller_pincode")
- provider_name: Display name of the seller/merchant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."provider_name")
- delivery_pincode: Indian postal code of the buyer's delivery address. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."delivery_pincode")
- is_error: Flag indicating whether the transaction encountered an ONDC protocol error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."is_error")
- error_code: ONDC protocol error code returned during the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."error_code")
- txn_timestamp: Timestamp of the transaction event. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."txn_timestamp")
- first_seen_date: Calendar date on which the transaction was first recorded in the system. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."first_seen_date")
- hour_of_day: Hour of the day (0–23) when the transaction event occurred. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."hour_of_day")
- min_trans_type_sp: Numeric encoding of the earliest ONDC protocol step reached in the transaction flow. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."min_trans_type_sp")
- max_trans_type_sp: Numeric encoding of the furthest ONDC protocol step reached in the transaction flow. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."max_trans_type_sp")
- max_error_trans_type_sp: Numeric encoding of the protocol step at which the last error occurred in the transaction flow. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."max_error_trans_type_sp")
- end_trans_type: The final ONDC protocol call type at which the transaction concluded (e.g., select, init, confirm). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."end_trans_type")
- dropped_due_to_error: Flag (1/0) indicating whether the transaction was abandoned due to an error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."dropped_due_to_error")
- qsr: Flag or label indicating whether the transaction involves a Quick Service Restaurant merchant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."qsr")
- Seller NP: Display name of the Seller-side Network Participant (BPP). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Seller NP")
- Buyer NP: Display name of the Buyer-side Network Participant (BAP). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Buyer NP")
- Call Type: Indicates whether the transaction was between the same Network Participant (Intra NP) or different Network Participants (Inter NP). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Call Type")
- error_message: Human-readable message describing the category of error encountered. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."error_message")
- error_category: Broader classification/category of the error type. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."error_category")
- provider_key: Composite surrogate key concatenating bpp_id and provider_id to uniquely identify a seller on a specific BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."provider_key")
- Seller State: Indian state where the seller is located, derived from seller pincode. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Seller State")
- Delivery State: Indian state of the delivery destination, derived from delivery pincode. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Delivery State")
- Seller City: District/city of the seller's location, derived from seller pincode. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Seller City")
- Delivery City: District/city of the delivery destination, derived from delivery pincode. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Delivery City")
- Seller Tier: City-tier classification (Tier 1/2/3) of the seller's location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Seller Tier")
- Delivery Tier: City-tier classification (Tier 1/2/3) of the delivery destination. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Delivery Tier")
- Seller Zone: Geographic zone of the seller's location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Seller Zone")
- Delivery Zone: Geographic zone of the delivery destination. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Delivery Zone")
- BNP Attributed Logistics: Flag (1/0) for dropped transactions where the logistics error is attributed to the Buyer Network Participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."BNP Attributed Logistics")
- BNP Attribution: Flag (1/0) for dropped transactions where overall error attribution is assigned to the Buyer Network Participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."BNP Attribution")
- BNP Attribution Inventory: Flag (1/0) for dropped transactions where an inventory error is attributed to the Buyer Network Participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."BNP Attribution Inventory")
- BNP Attribution Location: Flag (1/0) for dropped transactions where a location serviceability error is attributed to the Buyer Network Participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."BNP Attribution Location")
- BNP Attribution Merchant: Flag (1/0) for dropped transactions where a merchant error is attributed to the Buyer Network Participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."BNP Attribution Merchant")
- Cancelled (Select - Buyer): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction reached confirm stage but was subsequently cancelled by the buyer. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Cancelled (Select - Buyer)")
- Cancelled (Select - Logistics): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction reached confirm stage but was subsequently cancelled by logistics. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Cancelled (Select - Logistics)")
- Cancelled (Select - Seller): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction reached confirm stage but was subsequently cancelled by the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Cancelled (Select - Seller)")
- Confirm: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction successfully completed the confirm protocol step without a confirm-stage error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Confirm")
- Confirm to Delivered: Flag (1/0) indicating the order was confirmed and ultimately delivered to the buyer. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Confirm to Delivered")
- Confirm to inprocess: Flag (1/0) indicating the order was confirmed and is currently in processing/fulfilment. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Confirm to inprocess")
- Confirm_: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction progressed to at least the 5th ONDC protocol step (init stage or beyond), a broader funnel-reach indicator. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Confirm_")
- distance Shared Location: Flag (1/0) for dropped transactions where a distance-based location serviceability error caused the drop (excluding store-timing errors). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."distance Shared Location")
- Drop due to Error – Business Error (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to a Business Error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Business Error (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Internal Error (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to an Internal Error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Internal Error (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Invalid request (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to an invalid request error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Invalid request (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Item not found (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped because the requested item was not found. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Item not found (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Item quantity unavailable (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped because the requested item quantity was unavailable. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Item quantity unavailable (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Location Serviceability error (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to a location serviceability error with code 30010. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Location Serviceability error (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Location Serviceability error 30009 (abso: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to a location serviceability error with code 30009. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Location Serviceability error 30009 (abso")
- Drop due to Error – Maximum order qty exceeded (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped because the order quantity exceeded the maximum allowed. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Maximum order qty exceeded (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Merchant Inactive (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped because the merchant was inactive. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Merchant Inactive (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Merchant unavailable (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped because the merchant was unavailable. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Merchant unavailable (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Minimum order value error (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped because the order value was below the minimum threshold. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Minimum order value error (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Order Confirm Error (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to an error at the order confirm stage. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Order Confirm Error (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Order Serviceability error (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to an order serviceability error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Order Serviceability error (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Others (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to an unclassified or miscellaneous error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Others (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error – Stale Request (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to a stale or expired request. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error – Stale Request (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (inventory) absolute: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to an inventory error occurring between the Init and Confirm protocol steps. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (inventory) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (logistics) absolute: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to a logistics error between the Init and Confirm protocol steps. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error (Init-Confirm) (logistics) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (Select-Confirm) (absolute): Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to any error between the Select and Confirm protocol steps. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error (Select-Confirm) (absolute)")
- Drop due to Error (Select-Confirm) (inventory) absolute: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to an inventory error between Select and Confirm stages. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error (Select-Confirm) (inventory) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (logistics) absolute: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to a logistics error between Select and Confirm stages. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (logistics) absolute")
- Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (merchant) absolute: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was dropped due to a merchant error between Select and Confirm stages. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop due to Error (select-Confirm) (merchant) absolute")
- Drop not due to Error (Select-Confirm) absolute: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was abandoned between Select and Confirm stages without any protocol error (e.g., buyer exit). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop not due to Error (Select-Confirm) absolute")
- Drop not due to Error (Select-Init) absolute: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction was abandoned between Select and Init stages without any protocol error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Drop not due to Error (Select-Init) absolute")
- Error outside store timing Inventory: Flag (1/0) indicating an inventory error occurred outside the store's configured operating hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Error outside store timing Inventory")
- Error outside store timing Location: Flag (1/0) indicating a location serviceability error occurred outside the store's operating hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Error outside store timing Location")
- Error outside store timing Merchant: Flag (1/0) indicating a merchant error occurred outside the store's operating hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Error outside store timing Merchant")
- Errors Count: Total number of errors encountered across all protocol steps in the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Errors Count")
- Geo Json Shared Location: Flag (1/0) indicating the seller's serviceability zone was defined as a GeoJSON polygon. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Geo Json Shared Location")
- GPS Outside India Location: Flag (1/0) indicating the GPS coordinates provided fall outside India's geographic boundaries. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."GPS Outside India Location")
- Init: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction reached the Init protocol step. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Init")
- Invalid GPS Location: Flag (1/0) indicating invalid or malformed GPS coordinates were provided in the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Invalid GPS Location")
- Item available Inventory: Flag (1/0) indicating the requested item was confirmed available in the seller's inventory. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Item available Inventory")
- Item Not Received Inventory: Flag (1/0) indicating the item response was not received from the seller's inventory system. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Item Not Received Inventory")
- Item Timing Inventory: Flag (1/0) indicating an inventory error related to the item's availability time window. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Item Timing Inventory")
- Item Unavailable Inventory: Flag (1/0) indicating the requested item was confirmed unavailable in the seller's inventory. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Item Unavailable Inventory")
- LSP Attributed Logistics: Flag (1/0) for dropped transactions where the logistics error is attributed to the Logistics Service Provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."LSP Attributed Logistics")
- LSP Attribution: Flag (1/0) indicating overall drop attribution assigned to the Logistics Service Provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."LSP Attribution")
- Merchant No_on_search_error: Flag (1/0) indicating the merchant had no on_search event recorded before the error occurred. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Merchant No_on_search_error")
- No on_search before error Inventory: Flag (1/0) indicating no on_search response was received before the inventory error occurred. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."No on_search before error Inventory")
- on_confirm: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction received an on_confirm callback from the BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."on_confirm")
- on_init: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction received an on_init callback from the BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."on_init")
- on_select: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction received an on_select callback from the BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."on_select")
- Outside Menu Timing Inventory: Flag (1/0) indicating an inventory error caused by the request falling outside the seller's menu availability window. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Outside Menu Timing Inventory")
- pan_india Shared Location: Flag (1/0) indicating the seller configured pan-India serviceability (serves all of India). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."pan_india Shared Location")
- pincode Shared Location: Flag (1/0) indicating the seller's serviceability was defined using a pincode list. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."pincode Shared Location")
- Select: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction reached the Select protocol step. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Select")
- Select to Cancelled: Flag (1/0) indicating the transaction progressed from Select but was ultimately cancelled. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Select to Cancelled")
- SNP Attributed Logistics: Flag (1/0) for dropped transactions where the logistics error is attributed to the Seller Network Participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."SNP Attributed Logistics")
- SNP Attribution: Flag (1/0) indicating overall drop attribution assigned to the Seller Network Participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."SNP Attribution")
- SNP Attribution Inventory: Flag (1/0) indicating drop attributed to the Seller Network Participant due to an inventory error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."SNP Attribution Inventory")
- SNP Attribution Location: Flag (1/0) indicating drop attributed to the Seller Network Participant due to a location serviceability error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."SNP Attribution Location")
- SNP Attribution Merchant: Flag (1/0) indicating drop attributed to the Seller Network Participant due to a merchant error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."SNP Attribution Merchant")
- store marked closed before error: Flag (1/0) indicating the store had a closed status recorded before the error was triggered. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."store marked closed before error")
- Store marked closed before error Inventory: Flag (1/0) indicating the store was marked closed before an inventory error occurred. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Store marked closed before error Inventory")
- store marked open before error: Flag (1/0) indicating the store had an open status recorded before the error was triggered. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."store marked open before error")
- Tech Errors (select-confirm) absolute: Flag (1/0) indicating a technical (non-business) error occurred in the Select-to-Confirm stage. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Tech Errors (select-confirm) absolute")
- Unknown Attribution: Flag (1/0) indicating the attribution of the transaction drop could not be determined. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Unknown Attribution")
- Unknown Attribution Location: Flag (1/0) indicating the attribution of a location-related drop could not be determined. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."Unknown Attribution Location")
- unknown Shared Location: Flag (1/0) indicating the seller's serviceability type could not be classified. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_bv."unknown Shared Location")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage
Type: base table

Columns:
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the seller-side network participant (BPP) handling the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."bpp_id")
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the buyer-side network participant (BAP) that initiated the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."bap_id")
- domain: ONDC domain category of the transaction (e.g., retail food, grocery, fashion). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."domain")
- transaction_id: Unique end-to-end identifier for the ONDC transaction across all network participants. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."transaction_id")
- provider_id: Unique identifier of the seller/merchant (provider) on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."provider_id")
- order_status: Final or current lifecycle status of the order (e.g., Created, Accepted, Cancelled, Completed). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."order_status")
- cancellation_type: Classification of the cancellation indicating who initiated it and under what reason (e.g., buyer, seller, RTO). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."cancellation_type")
- seller_pincode: Indian postal code of the seller/merchant's operating location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."seller_pincode")
- provider_name: Display name of the seller/merchant as registered on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."provider_name")
- delivery_pincode: Indian postal code of the buyer's delivery address. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."delivery_pincode")
- is_error: Flag indicating whether the transaction encountered an error at any funnel stage. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."is_error")
- error_code: ONDC-standard error code returned at the point of transaction failure. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."error_code")
- txn_timestamp: Timestamp of the transaction event being recorded in the funnel. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."txn_timestamp")
- first_seen_date: Date when this transaction was first observed entering the funnel. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."first_seen_date")
- hour_of_day: Hour of the day (0–23) when the transaction occurred, used for time-of-day pattern analysis. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."hour_of_day")
- min_trans_type_sp: Integer encoding of the earliest/minimum funnel stage reached in this transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."min_trans_type_sp")
- max_trans_type_sp: Integer encoding of the furthest funnel stage successfully reached in this transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."max_trans_type_sp")
- max_error_trans_type_sp: Integer encoding of the funnel stage at which the furthest error occurred. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."max_error_trans_type_sp")
- end_trans_type: Final transaction stage/type at which the transaction terminated in the ONDC funnel. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."end_trans_type")
- dropped_due_to_error: Flag (1/0) indicating whether the transaction was abandoned as a direct result of an error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."dropped_due_to_error")
- qsr: Flag indicating whether the provider is classified as a Quick Service Restaurant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."qsr")
- error_type_flag: Categorical label for the primary type of error encountered (e.g., merchant, inventory, serviceability, logistics). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."error_type_flag")
- error_context_ts_ist: Timestamp in IST of the ONDC protocol context in which the error was generated. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."error_context_ts_ist")
- provider_location_id: Unique identifier of the specific branch or outlet of the provider where the order was placed. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."provider_location_id")
- provider_order_timings: Declared business/operational hours of the provider during which orders are accepted. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."provider_order_timings")
- provider_last_on_search_type: Type of the most recent on_search catalogue event in which this provider appeared. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."provider_last_on_search_type")
- provider_last_status_on_search_id: Identifier of the on_search call in which the provider's last operational status was recorded. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."provider_last_status_on_search_id")
- provider_last_status_timestamp: Timestamp of the provider's most recent status update on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."provider_last_status_timestamp")
- provider_last_status: Last known operational status of the provider (e.g., open, closed) at the time of the error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."provider_last_status")
- error_store_timing_flag: Flag indicating whether the error is correlated with the store being outside its declared operating hours. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."error_store_timing_flag")
- buyer_attributed_merchant_error: Flag (1/0) indicating a merchant-side error is attributed to buyer-driven factors. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."buyer_attributed_merchant_error")
- seller_attributed_merchant_error: Flag (1/0) indicating a merchant-side error is attributed to the seller/provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."seller_attributed_merchant_error")
- store_error_diff_mins: Difference in minutes between the error event and the store's nearest operating-hours boundary. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."store_error_diff_mins")
- store_error_diff_hours: Difference in hours between the error event and the store's nearest operating-hours boundary. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."store_error_diff_hours")
- store_error_recency_flag: Categorical flag describing how recently a store timing issue occurred relative to the error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."store_error_recency_flag")
- pc_item_name: Name of the ordered item as it appears in the provider's product catalogue. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."pc_item_name")
- item_id: Unique identifier of the item/SKU in the provider's catalogue. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."item_id")
- item_type: Type or classification of the catalogue item (e.g., item, variant, customisation). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."item_type")
- custom_menu_name: Name of the custom menu or sub-category grouping to which the item belongs. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."custom_menu_name")
- custom_menu_id: Unique identifier of the custom menu grouping the item. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."custom_menu_id")
- pc_item_label: Label or dietary tag assigned to the item in the catalogue (e.g., veg, non-veg, egg). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."pc_item_label")
- pc_item_available_quantity: Stock quantity of the item as declared in the provider's product catalogue at the time of the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."pc_item_available_quantity")
- item_last_on_search_type: Type of the most recent on_search event in which this item appeared as available. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."item_last_on_search_type")
- item_last_transaction: Identifier or type of the most recent transaction in which this item was involved prior to the current one. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."item_last_transaction")
- item_last_status_timestamp: Timestamp of the item's most recent availability status update in the catalogue. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."item_last_status_timestamp")
- item_last_status: Last known availability status of the item (e.g., available, unavailable) at the time of the error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."item_last_status")
- error_item_timing_flag: Flag indicating whether the error is correlated with item-level availability timing. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."error_item_timing_flag")
- error_menu_timing_flag: Flag indicating whether the error is correlated with the custom menu's availability timing window. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."error_menu_timing_flag")
- buyer_attributed_inventory_error: Flag (1/0) indicating an inventory/item error is attributed to buyer behavior. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."buyer_attributed_inventory_error")
- seller_attributed_inventory_error: Flag (1/0) indicating an inventory/item error is attributed to the seller's catalogue management. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."seller_attributed_inventory_error")
- item_error_diff_mins: Difference in minutes between the error and the item's last known status change. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."item_error_diff_mins")
- item_error_diff_hours: Difference in hours between the error and the item's last known status change. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."item_error_diff_hours")
- item_error_recency_flag: Categorical flag describing how recently the item's availability status changed relative to the error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."item_error_recency_flag")
- pc_delivery_gps: GPS coordinates (latitude, longitude) of the buyer's delivery address as provided in the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."pc_delivery_gps")
- is_valid_gps: Flag (1/0) indicating whether the delivery GPS coordinates are valid and parseable. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."is_valid_gps")
- is_valid_pincode: Flag (1/0) indicating whether the delivery pincode is a valid Indian postal code. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."is_valid_pincode")
- is_within_india: Flag (1/0) indicating whether the delivery GPS coordinates fall within India's geographic boundary. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."is_within_india")
- serviceability_type_label: Label describing the method used for serviceability validation (e.g., pincode-based, geofence-based). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."serviceability_type_label")
- serviceability_verifiability: Indicates whether the provider's serviceability claim can be independently verified against available data. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."serviceability_verifiability")
- provider_location_serviceability_unit: Granularity unit used by the provider to define their delivery serviceability area (e.g., pincode, polygon). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."provider_location_serviceability_unit")
- geojson_type: Type of GeoJSON geometry used to define the provider's serviceability boundary (e.g., Polygon, MultiPolygon). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."geojson_type")
- geojson_status: Status indicating whether a valid GeoJSON serviceability definition exists and is usable for this provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."geojson_status")
- geo_json_shared: Flag (1/0) indicating whether the provider has shared a GeoJSON polygon defining their serviceability area. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."geo_json_shared")
- delivery_within_geofence: Flag (1/0) indicating whether the delivery address GPS falls within the provider's GeoJSON geofence. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."delivery_within_geofence")
- within_pincode_fence: Flag (1/0) indicating whether the delivery pincode is within the provider's declared serviceable pincode list. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."within_pincode_fence")
- buyer_attributed_serviceability_error: Flag (1/0) indicating a serviceability error is attributed to the buyer ordering outside the provider's coverage area. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."buyer_attributed_serviceability_error")
- seller_attributed_serviceability_error: Flag (1/0) indicating a serviceability error is attributed to an incorrect or missing serviceability definition by the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."seller_attributed_serviceability_error")
- unknown_attributed_serviceability_error: Flag (1/0) indicating a serviceability error whose attribution cannot be determined. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."unknown_attributed_serviceability_error")
- buyer_attributed_logistics: Flag (1/0) indicating a logistics failure is attributed to buyer-driven factors (e.g., wrong address, unavailability). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."buyer_attributed_logistics")
- lsp_attributed_logistics: Flag (1/0) indicating a logistics failure is attributed to the Logistics Service Provider. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."lsp_attributed_logistics")
- seller_attributed_logistics: Flag (1/0) indicating a logistics failure is attributed to seller actions (e.g., delayed handover). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."seller_attributed_logistics")
- buyer_others_attributed: Flag (1/0) indicating miscellaneous errors outside standard categories are attributed to the buyer. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."buyer_others_attributed")
- seller_others_attributed: Flag (1/0) indicating miscellaneous errors outside standard categories are attributed to the seller. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."seller_others_attributed")
- overall_buyer_attributed: Aggregate flag (1/0) indicating the overall transaction failure is attributed to the buyer across all error dimensions. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."overall_buyer_attributed")
- overall_seller_attributed: Aggregate flag (1/0) indicating the overall transaction failure is attributed to the seller across all error dimensions. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."overall_seller_attributed")
- overall_lsp_attributed: Aggregate flag (1/0) indicating the overall transaction failure is attributed to the Logistics Service Provider across all dimensions. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."overall_lsp_attributed")
- overall_unknown_attributed: Aggregate flag (1/0) indicating the overall transaction failure attribution is indeterminate across all error dimensions. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_funnel_v2_stage."overall_unknown_attributed")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_item_error
Type: base table

Columns:
- created_at: Date the error record was logged in the warehouse. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."created_at")
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the Buyer App (BAP) network participant that initiated the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."bap_id")
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the Seller App (BPP) network participant that received and processed the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."bpp_id")
- transaction_id: ONDC session-level transaction ID linking all API calls between buyer and seller for a single purchase flow. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."transaction_id")
- action: ONDC API action (e.g., search, select, init, confirm, status) during which the error was raised. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."action")
- domain: ONDC vertical or category domain (e.g., retail, grocery, F&B) under which the transaction was conducted. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."domain")
- Provider ID: Unique identifier of the seller or provider entity listed on the BPP platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."Provider ID")
- error_code: ONDC-standardized error code indicating the category or cause of the failure returned in the API response. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."error_code")
- key: Specific field or JSON path within the catalog or order payload that triggered the validation or processing error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."key")
- msg_id_count: Count of distinct message IDs associated with this error, reflecting how many API calls encountered it. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."msg_id_count")
- item_id: Unique identifier of the catalog item whose data or processing caused the error. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."item_id")
- txn_id x action timestamp: Composite deduplication key combining transaction ID, API action, and timestamp to uniquely fingerprint a single error event. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error."txn_id x action timestamp")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage
Type: base table

Columns:
- created_at: Date the error record was captured in the staging table (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."created_at")
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the Buyer App Network Participant (BAP) that initiated the transaction (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."bap_id")
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the Seller App Network Participant (BPP) that fulfilled or responded to the transaction (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."bpp_id")
- transaction_id: ONDC session-level identifier linking all API calls (search through confirm) for a single buyer journey (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."transaction_id")
- action: ONDC API lifecycle call (e.g., search, select, init, confirm, on_confirm) during which the error was raised (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."action")
- domain: ONDC sector vertical under which the transaction was conducted (e.g., ONDC:RET10 for grocery, ONDC:RET12 for fashion) (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."domain")
- Provider ID: Unique identifier of the seller or provider on the BPP whose catalog entry is associated with the error (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."Provider ID")
- error_code: ONDC-defined numeric error code returned by the network participant describing the failure type (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."error_code")
- key: Specific JSON payload field or parameter path that failed validation or triggered the error (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."key")
- msg_id_count: Count of distinct message IDs sharing this error, indicating how many individual API messages were affected (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."msg_id_count")
- item_id: Unique identifier of the catalog item or SKU on the provider's inventory that is linked to the error (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."item_id")
- txn_id x action timestamp: Composite surrogate key concatenating transaction ID, action name, and timestamp to uniquely fingerprint a single API call instance (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_item_error_stage."txn_id x action timestamp")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel
Type: base table

Columns:
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the Beckn Provider Platform (seller-side network participant) that fulfilled or attempted to fulfill the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."bpp_id")
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the Beckn Application Platform (buyer-side network participant) through which the buyer placed the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."bap_id")
- domain: ONDC category domain under which the transaction occurred (e.g., retail grocery, F&B, fashion). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."domain")
- transaction_id: Globally unique identifier for the ONDC order transaction across the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."transaction_id")
- provider_id: Unique identifier of the seller or merchant as registered on the BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."provider_id")
- order_status: Final or current lifecycle status of the order (e.g., Created, Accepted, Completed, Cancelled). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."order_status")
- cancellation_type: Reason or initiating party for order cancellation (e.g., buyer-initiated, seller-initiated, RTO). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."cancellation_type")
- seller_pincode: Indian postal code of the seller's warehouse or dispatch location. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."seller_pincode")
- provider_name: Display name of the seller or merchant as registered on the BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."provider_name")
- delivery_pincode: Indian postal code of the buyer's delivery destination. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."delivery_pincode")
- is_error: Flag indicating whether the transaction encountered one or more errors during its lifecycle. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."is_error")
- error_code: ONDC-standard error code identifying the specific failure or exception in the transaction flow. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."error_code")
- first_seen_date: Calendar date on which the transaction was first recorded in the data warehouse. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."first_seen_date")
- hour_of_day: Hour of the day (0–23) when the transaction was initiated, used for intra-day demand pattern analysis. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."hour_of_day")
- min_trans_type_sp: Numeric encoding of the earliest ONDC API stage (e.g., search, select) reached in this transaction's funnel. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."min_trans_type_sp")
- max_trans_type_sp: Numeric encoding of the furthest ONDC API stage reached in this transaction, indicating how deep into the order funnel it progressed. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."max_trans_type_sp")
- max_error_trans_type_sp: Numeric encoding of the most advanced ONDC API stage at which an error was encountered during the transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."max_error_trans_type_sp")
- end_trans_type: The last ONDC API call type (e.g., confirm, cancel, on_status) that concluded the transaction lifecycle. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."end_trans_type")
- qsr: Indicates whether the transaction belongs to the Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) sub-segment within the F&B domain. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel."qsr")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage
Type: base table

Columns:
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the seller-side network participant (BPP) that hosts the provider on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."bpp_id")
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the buyer-side network participant (BAP) through which the buyer placed the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."bap_id")
- domain: ONDC domain/sub-domain category of the transaction (e.g., retail:grocery, retail:fashion). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."domain")
- transaction_id: Unique ONDC protocol transaction ID that ties all API calls (search → confirm → status) for a single order journey. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."transaction_id")
- provider_id: Unique identifier of the individual seller/merchant on the BPP platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."provider_id")
- order_status: Lifecycle status of the order as reported by the BPP (e.g., Created, Accepted, In-Transit, Cancelled, Completed). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."order_status")
- cancellation_type: Classification of who triggered the cancellation and the reason category (e.g., buyer-initiated, seller-initiated, RTO). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."cancellation_type")
- seller_pincode: Indian postal code (pincode) of the seller's fulfillment location or warehouse. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."seller_pincode")
- provider_name: Display name of the seller/merchant as registered on the BPP. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."provider_name")
- delivery_pincode: Indian postal code of the buyer's delivery destination address. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."delivery_pincode")
- is_error: Flag indicating whether any ONDC protocol call in this transaction returned an error response from a network participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."is_error")
- error_code: ONDC protocol error code received during the transaction, identifying the nature of the failure. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."error_code")
- first_seen_date: Calendar date on which this transaction was first ingested or observed in the data warehouse. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."first_seen_date")
- hour_of_day: Hour of the day (0–23) at which the transaction was initiated, used for intra-day traffic analysis. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."hour_of_day")
- min_trans_type_sp: Numeric sequence position of the earliest ONDC funnel stage (transaction type) observed for this transaction. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."min_trans_type_sp")
- max_trans_type_sp: Numeric sequence position of the furthest ONDC funnel stage reached, indicating how deep into the order flow the transaction progressed. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."max_trans_type_sp")
- max_error_trans_type_sp: Numeric sequence position of the furthest ONDC funnel stage at which an error was encountered. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."max_error_trans_type_sp")
- end_trans_type: The final ONDC API action type (e.g., search, select, init, confirm, cancel) at which the transaction terminated. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."end_trans_type")
- qsr: Flag or category indicating whether the order belongs to a Quick Service Restaurant (QSR) merchant segment within the food domain. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_funnel_stage."qsr")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm
Type: base table

Columns:
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the Buyer App Provider (buyer-side network participant) associated with the grievance ticket. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."bap_id")
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the Seller App Provider (seller-side network participant) against whom the issue is raised. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."bpp_id")
- ticket_created_date: Timestamp when the IGM grievance ticket was created in the system. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket_created_date")
- Date: Calendar date (without time) corresponding to the ticket creation, used for daily aggregation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."Date")
- domain: ONDC network domain of the order (e.g., retail, food and beverages) under which the grievance falls. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."domain")
- network_issue_id: Unique identifier assigned to the issue across the ONDC network's IGM system. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."network_issue_id")
- ticket_category: High-level classification of the grievance nature (e.g., item, fulfillment, payment). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket_category")
- ticket_sub_category: Second-level classification providing a more specific issue type within the ticket category. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket_sub_category")
- ticket_sub_cat: Cleaned or mapped alternate representation of ticket sub-category, used for standardized reporting. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket_sub_cat")
- Resolved: Indicator flag or label denoting whether the grievance ticket has been resolved. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."Resolved")
- network_order_id: Unique identifier of the ONDC network order linked to the grievance. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."network_order_id")
- ticket_key: System-level unique key identifying the IGM ticket record. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket_key")
- ticket_source: Entity or channel that originated the ticket (e.g., buyer, seller, logistics partner). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket_source")
- ticket count: Count of grievance tickets represented by the record, used for aggregation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket count")
- ticket_raiser: Network participant role (BAP, BPP, or LSP) that raised the grievance. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket_raiser")
- ticket_expected_resolution_time: SLA deadline timestamp by which the ticket must be resolved per ONDC IGM TAT norms. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket_expected_resolution_time")
- ticket_status: Current lifecycle status of the IGM ticket (e.g., Open, Resolved, Closed). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."ticket_status")
- Closed date: Timestamp when the ticket was officially closed by the resolving party. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."Closed date")
- r_action_ticket_resolved_date: Timestamp when the respondent network participant marked their action on the ticket as resolved. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."r_action_ticket_resolved_date")
- category: Product or order category (e.g., grocery, electronics) associated with the disputed order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."category")
- Order Date: Timestamp when the original order linked to this grievance was placed on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."Order Date")
- seller_name: Display name of the seller or merchant on the BPP platform associated with the order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."seller_name")
- provider_id: Unique identifier of the seller/provider entity on the BPP platform. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."provider_id")
- on_issue_error_code: Error code returned by the BPP in the on_issue API callback during the IGM protocol flow. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."on_issue_error_code")
- issue_sync_response: Response payload or status received during issue synchronization API exchange between network participants. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."issue_sync_response")
- tat_diff(open): Difference in days between ticket creation and expected resolution time, indicating TAT headroom or breach while ticket is open. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."tat_diff(open)")
- sec_diff(open): Difference in seconds between ticket creation and expected resolution timestamp, for fine-grained open-ticket TAT analysis. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."sec_diff(open)")
- min_diff(resolved): Difference in minutes between ticket creation and actual resolution timestamp, measuring end-to-end resolution speed. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."min_diff(resolved)")
- tat_diff(res): Difference in days between expected resolution time and actual resolution date, where positive values indicate a TAT breach. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm."tat_diff(res)")

Table: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv
Type: view

Columns:
- bap_id: Unique identifier of the Buyer App Network Participant (BAP) that raised the grievance ticket. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."bap_id")
- bpp_id: Unique identifier of the Seller App Network Participant (BPP) against whom the grievance was raised. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."bpp_id")
- ticket_created_date: Timestamp when the IGM grievance ticket was created on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket_created_date")
- Date: Calendar date (without time component) on which the ticket was created. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Date")
- domain: ONDC network domain under which the order and issue are categorised (e.g., retail, logistics). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."domain")
- network_issue_id: Unique issue identifier assigned by the ONDC network for end-to-end grievance tracking. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."network_issue_id")
- ticket_category: High-level issue category as defined in the ONDC IGM specification (e.g., fulfillment, item, payment). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket_category")
- ticket_sub_category: Second-level classification of the issue under its primary ticket category. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket_sub_category")
- ticket_sub_cat: Normalised or alternate sub-category label for the issue used for reporting consistency. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket_sub_cat")
- Resolved: Resolution status of the ticket: 'Yes' (resolved), 'No' (unresolved), or 'Forced Resolved' (administratively closed). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Resolved")
- network_order_id: ONDC network-level order identifier linking the grievance ticket to the originating retail order. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."network_order_id")
- ticket_key: Unique key assigned to the ticket within the grievance management system. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket_key")
- ticket_source: Channel or system through which the ticket was originally submitted. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket_source")
- ticket count: Row-level ticket count (typically 1) used as a summable metric in aggregations. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket count")
- ticket_raiser: Party that raised the ticket — buyer, seller, or logistics network participant. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket_raiser")
- ticket_expected_resolution_time: SLA/TAT deadline timestamp by which the ticket is contractually expected to be resolved. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket_expected_resolution_time")
- ticket_status: Current workflow status of the ticket on the network (e.g., OPEN, CLOSED, RESOLVED). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ticket_status")
- Closed date: Timestamp when the ticket was officially closed on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Closed date")
- r_action_ticket_resolved_date: Timestamp when the responding party (seller NP) marked the ticket as resolved in their system. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."r_action_ticket_resolved_date")
- category: Standardised issue category used for analytics grouping, may differ from the raw ticket_category field. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."category")
- Order Date: Timestamp of the original retail order associated with this grievance. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Order Date")
- seller_name: Display name of the seller whose order is the subject of the grievance. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."seller_name")
- provider_id: Unique identifier of the seller or provider on the ONDC network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."provider_id")
- on_issue_error_code: Error code returned by the seller NP in the on_issue callback, indicating a processing error or rejection. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."on_issue_error_code")
- issue_sync_response: Synchronous response (ACK or NACK) from the seller NP when the issue was first transmitted to them. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."issue_sync_response")
- tat_diff(open): Seconds by which an unresolved ticket has exceeded (positive) or remains within (negative or zero) its TAT deadline. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."tat_diff(open)")
- sec_diff(open): Age in seconds of an unresolved ticket, measured from creation time to the current snapshot. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."sec_diff(open)")
- min_diff(resolved): Duration in seconds between ticket creation and resolution for resolved tickets (used to bucket resolution speed into day ranges). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."min_diff(resolved)")
- tat_diff(res): Difference in seconds between the actual resolution timestamp and the TAT deadline; negative or zero means resolved within SLA. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."tat_diff(res)")
- Seller NP: Display name of the Seller Network Participant, looked up from the seller NP dimension table via bpp_id. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Seller NP")
- Buyer NP: Display name of the Buyer Network Participant, looked up from the buyer NP dimension table via bap_id. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Buyer NP")
