- rejected: Binary flag (1 = rejected, 0 = accepted) indicating whether the seller NP rejected the issue via NACK or a non-empty error code. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."rejected")
- Rejected Retail: Ticket count for rows where the seller NP rejected the issue (NACK response or non-empty on_issue error code). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Rejected Retail")
- Ticket_new_count: Ticket count for valid, non-rejected tickets successfully accepted by the seller NP on the network. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Ticket_new_count")
- NACK Retail: Ticket count for tickets where the seller NP returned a synchronous NACK response upon issue receipt. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."NACK Retail")
- ACK Retail: Ticket count for tickets where the seller NP returned a synchronous ACK response upon issue receipt. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."ACK Retail")
- On_Issue Error Retail: Ticket count for tickets where the seller NP's on_issue callback contained a non-null error code. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."On_Issue Error Retail")
- resolved_ticket: Ticket count for tickets with resolution status 'Yes' (genuinely resolved by the seller NP). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."resolved_ticket")
- unresolved_ticket: Ticket count for tickets with resolution status 'No' (not yet resolved). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."unresolved_ticket")
- forced_resolved_ticket: Ticket count for tickets administratively closed by the network as 'Forced Resolved' without genuine seller resolution. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."forced_resolved_ticket")
- Unresolved and not closed: Ticket count for tickets that are both unresolved and still in a non-CLOSED status, i.e., actively pending action. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Unresolved and not closed")
- Resolution within TAT: Ticket count for resolved tickets where resolution occurred at or before the TAT deadline. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Resolution within TAT")
- No Resolution & within TAT: Ticket count for unresolved tickets that have not yet breached their TAT deadline. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."No Resolution & within TAT")
- No Resolution & outside TAT: Ticket count for unresolved tickets that have exceeded their TAT deadline and are overdue. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."No Resolution & outside TAT")
- Resolved Ticket (0–1 day) (Retail): Count of resolved retail tickets where resolution time was within 0 to 1 day of creation. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Resolved Ticket (0–1 day) (Retail)")
- Resolved Ticket (1–3 day) (Retail): Count of resolved retail tickets where resolution time was between 1 and 3 days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Resolved Ticket (1–3 day) (Retail)")
- Resolved Ticket (3–5 day) (Retail): Count of resolved retail tickets where resolution time was between 3 and 5 days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Resolved Ticket (3–5 day) (Retail)")
- Resolved Ticket(5-10 day) (Retail): Count of resolved retail tickets where resolution time was between 5 and 10 days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Resolved Ticket(5-10 day) (Retail)")
- Resolved Ticket (Above 10 days) (Retail): Count of resolved retail tickets where resolution time exceeded 10 days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Resolved Ticket (Above 10 days) (Retail)")
- Unresolved Ticket (0–1 day) (Retail): Count of currently unresolved retail tickets that have been open for less than 1 day. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Unresolved Ticket (0–1 day) (Retail)")
- Unresolved Ticket (1–3 day) (Retail): Count of currently unresolved retail tickets that have been open between 1 and 3 days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Unresolved Ticket (1–3 day) (Retail)")
- Unresolved Ticket (3–5 day) (Retail): Count of currently unresolved retail tickets that have been open between 3 and 5 days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Unresolved Ticket (3–5 day) (Retail)")
- Unresolved Ticket (5–10 day) (Retail): Count of currently unresolved retail tickets that have been open between 5 and 10 days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Unresolved Ticket (5–10 day) (Retail)")
- Unresolved Ticket (Above 10 days) (Retail): Count of currently unresolved retail tickets that have been open for more than 10 days. (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Unresolved Ticket (Above 10 days) (Retail)")
- Average Resolved Time: Time taken to resolve the ticket expressed in fractional days (null for unresolved tickets). (Formula: analytics_insight.retail_order_igm_bv."Average Resolved Time")
